stages.stage: 2. Enhancement: high-pass, optional vocal separation, auto denoise, loudness
stages.what_it_does_now: Optionally runs Demucs htdemucs two-stems. Applies a 60 Hz 4th-order zero-phase Butterworth high-pass (sosfiltfilt). Estimates SNR as the 95th minus the 10th percentile of frame RMS dB. If denoise=auto and SNR < 25 dB, runs noisereduce (stationary, prop_decrease 0.6, n_std_thresh_stationary 1.5). Then normalizes the whole file to -20 LUFS with one global gain, and scales the whole file down if its peak exceeds -1 dBFS. Records orig_lufs / snr_before / denoised / separated in sources.json. Downstream, GPT-SoVITS 2-get-hubert-wav32k.py also re-scales every clip: wav32k = 0.5 x (peak normalized to 0.95) + 0.5 x original. It skips clips with peak > 2.2 and retries in fp32 on NaN.

stages.stage: 3. Slicing (energy / sidecar SRT)
stages.what_it_does_now: Energy mode: frames 10 ms. Silence threshold auto = max(speech95 - 30, noise3 + 6, -65), capped at speech95 - 15. Silent runs >= 300 ms split regions; regions < 0.25 s are dropped. Neighbours are merged while the group is < 3 s, or the gap is <= 0.5 s and the total is <= 9 s. Short tails merge into the previous group. Groups > 12 s are recursively force-cut at the smoothed energy minimum with a center-bias penalty (forced_cuts counted). Each clip keeps min(gap/2, 0.4 s) of silence on each side. Clips < 0.5 s are dropped. gap_before / gap_after / inner_gaps are recorded for the style profile. SRT mode (a same-named .srt/.vtt next to the media): cues are grouped (min 3 s, max 12 s, join gap 0.6 s, prefer sentence ends), and boundaries are refined to the energy minimum within +-0.3 s, padded by 0.06 s each side. The cue text replaces ASR.

stages.stage: 6. Language tags and the training text front end for mixed zh/en (largest gap)
stages.what_it_does_now: Each clip gets one tag. detect_lang returns zh if CJK chars >= max(1, 0.2 x English words), else en. The teacher can switch zh/en in the review table. train.list writes `wav|exp|<zh/en>|text`. The official 1-get-text.py runs clean_text(text, lang) on the WHOLE line. For zh that is chinese2.text_normalize, whose replace_punctuation keeps only [一-龥] plus punctuation. Every Latin letter is therefore deleted before g2p, and BERT is computed on the letter-stripped text. At inference, api_v2 with text_lang zh goes through TextPreprocessor.get_phones_and_bert. stages.stage: 12. Automatic best-model selection and speed calibration
stages.what_it_does_now: Uses up to 20 val clips; if there are none, it falls back to 3-9 s kept clips. Builds the SimilarityJudge: precise ensemble ReDimNet2-B6 + ERes2NetV2-zh + ERes2Net-base-zh with VAD and AS-norm. Calibration: 100 % = median of the val clips against the centroid of up to 80 train clips (speaker_sim-ranked, spread); 0 % = 95th percentile of 480 strangers. The single-encoder fallback is used when the ensemble is unavailable. Loads a CER checker. Embeds the real val clips. Starts api_v2. For each checkpoint in the grid and each item: one synthesis with seed 1234, speed 1.0, no aux refs, sampling from config infer, and ref = pick_reference(refs minus item, lang, kind) — always the top-scored same-language statement reference (the question reference for question items). The output is trimmed, then scored: to_voice = mean over members of cos(gen, centroid) / p50; to_real = mean of cos(gen, same-sentence real clip) / p50; calibrated pct is computed and logged only; CER from the ASR check; rhythm_dev = median |log(gen_voiced / real_voiced)|. total = to_voice + to_real - 2 x CER - 0.8 x rhythm_dev, and the maximum wins. If ASR fails mid-way, CER is removed for all checkpoints. Speed calibration per language = clip(median duration ratio of the winner, 0.8, 1.25) if |ratio - 1| > 0.03. Selected checkpoint, speed and ranking go to models.json. On the teacher's material that is 12 combinations x 20 items = 240 syntheses.

stages.what_it_does_now: parse_script cleans Markdown and turns pause markers ([停顿], [停顿=1.5], <break>) into pause_after values. It splits sentences on 。！？!?；;… and on English '.' (decimals and abbreviations excluded). A sentence under min_units syllables is merged into the next one. A sentence over max_units is cut at clause punctuation (，,、：:—), with a hard split as a last resort. Each chunk becomes one TTS request. pause_after is 'clause' between chunks, 'sentence' after a sentence, 'paragraph' after the last sentence of a paragraph, or an explicit number of seconds; the last segment gets 0. tts_normalize replaces ——/-- with ，, turns digit ranges a~b into 到 / to, removes brackets and adds final punctuation. The lexicon is applied. kind is sentence_kind of the whole sentence (？ → question, ！ → exclaim, otherwise statement). lang is detect_lang(tts_text).

Probe: '比如 This is a very long English example sentence used to show the rule clearly.' gives detect_lang='en'. In 'en' mode, GPT-SoVITS g2p passes CJK tokens through unchanged and replace_phs drops any symbol that is not in the phone set ('ph not in symbols'), so the Chinese words are silently not spoken. The CER check does not catch this reliably: for lang 'en' the CER is computed per character over Latin letters (2 missing CJK characters against about 60 letters is about 3%), and Whisper runs with language='en'. English segments use English references only if the teacher has English clips that pass the reference rules (quota at least 2 per language when any exist); otherwise a Chinese reference with prompt_lang zh is used. The speaker models are mostly Chinese-trained (English 2 s EER 1.09% vs Chinese 0.05%, research/sv_benchmark/记录.md §10), and calibration pools both languages. English example sentences are therefore probably scored lower and noisier, which means more retries and flags; this has not been measured on the teacher's voice.

A user-forced reference id overrides this for every sentence. prompt_text is ref['text'], the proofread transcript; GPT-SoVITS appends 。 when it does not end in punctuation. GPT-SoVITS set_seed seeds random, numpy, torch and CUDA once per request, which fixes the GPT multinomial sampling and the VITS noise. It does not send batch_threshold, split_bucket, overlap_length or min_chunk_length.

WHAT EACH FIELD DOES FOR v2ProPlus (abe9843 TTS.py):
- seed → set_seed (194-214) seeds random, numpy, torch and CUDA per request (tf32 off). It fixes GPT multinomial sampling and the VITS noise.
- top_k, top_p, temperature, repetition_penalty → GPT infer_panel (1270-1280); infer_panel_batch_infer when parallel_infer is on (1065-1067).
- noise_scale is fixed at 0.5: SynthesizerTrn.decode default (models.py 995, z_p noise at 1034), called without it (TTS.py 1317, 1333). It cannot be set through api_v2.
- ref_audio_path → prompt_semantic via HuBERT, with a hard 3-10 s check at 16 kHz (809-817), plus spec and 16 kHz audio for timbre (_get_ref_spec 772-807). It is recomputed only when the path changes.
- prompt_text → GPT prompt phones; 。 or . is appended when there is no final punctuation (1153-1166). An empty prompt_text switches to reference-free mode.
- aux_ref_audio_paths → appended to refer_spec (1140-1151; a missing file is skipped with a print; no length check). For v2Pro/v2ProPlus each reference gets sv_emb = SV.compute_embedding3 (1259-1264; sv.py uses GPT_SoVITS/pretrained_models/sv/pretrained_eres2netv2w24s4ep4.ckpt). decode computes ge = prelu(ref_enc(spec[:, :704]) + sv_emb_proj) per reference and takes the mean over references (models.py 996-1017). So aux references change timbre only; the GPT prompt comes from the main reference.
- speed_factor → content-feature interpolation in enc_p (models.py 1026-1033). It disables split_bucket (TTS.py 1097-1101) and selects the serial VITS path; there is no waveform time-stretch (speed_change is commented out, 1595-1599).
- fragment_interval → appends that many seconds of exact zeros after each fragment (audio_postprocess 1551-1561); output is int16 via ×32768 (1593), which can wrap at +1.0 (VoiceTwin fixes this in _fix_int16_wrap, gptsovits.py 219).
- sample_steps and super_sampling → used only when use_vocoder is true (v3/v4) (1337-1350, 1406, 1470). No effect on v2ProPlus.
- batch_size, batch_threshold, split_bucket → irrelevant for one fragment with cut0.
- Errors inside run → it yields 1 s of 16 kHz zeros with HTTP 200 and reloads the models (1516-1525). VoiceTwin detects this with _silent_answer (gptsovits.py 258).
- Output sample rate = SoVITS hps sampling_rate (TTS.py 526), which is 32000 for v2ProPlus.

TEXT AND LANGUAGE (TextPreprocessor.py):
- pre_seg_text (77-115) prepends 。 (or .) when the first phrase is under 4 characters and appends 。/. when the text has no final split character; split_big_text applies above 510 characters.
- get_phones_and_bert (122-195): 'en' sends the whole text to English g2p; 'zh' (and the other non-all modes) uses LangSegmenter, sending English runs to English g2p and the rest to Chinese. If there are fewer than 6 phones it re-runs with '.' prepended (186).
- get_bert_inf (212-222): BERT features exist only for zh; English gets zeros in both modes.
- english.py: non-Latin tokens pass through as their own 'phone' (__call__ 281-282) and replace_phs (111-121) drops anything not in the symbol set. So CJK characters inside a text_lang='en' request are silently not spoken. VoiceTwin's detect_lang (textutil.py 29-35) does send mixed text as 'en' when CJK < 0.2 × English words; verified by probe: '比如 This is a very long English example sentence used to show the rule clearly.' gives 'en'.

designs.summary:
This design for 「一模一样」 ("identical") comes at it from inference-time search. The idea is to turn the 完美 loop into a measured search. 完美 tries one reference, 3 sampling presets and up to 20 tries, and stops at the first candidate that passes. 「一模一样」 instead runs a successive-halving search over arms. An arm is one combination of main reference, aux set, sampling preset, optional speed nudge and checkpoint. On a mid-tier GPU it scores 40–64 candidates per sentence.

Two code-verified mechanisms make that affordable on 8 GB.

(1) Several candidates from one real api_v2 request. The sentence is sent as N copies separated by "\n", with cut0 and batch_size=N. The GPT samples each row independently (abe9843 t2s_model.py 583-723). Sending speed_factor 1.0001 forces the per-fragment VITS path (TTS.py 1262-1271) instead of the concatenated decode (1236-1259). At 1.0001, models.py 259-260 does not resample the features: I checked int(L/1.0001)+1 == L for every L up to 9999. The answer is then split on the exact-zero fragment gaps. I replicated pre_seg_text and ran all 1004 of the teacher's lines through it: every line gives exactly 4 identical fragments. Very short texts merge, so the code falls back to single requests for them. The split is checked strictly, there is a self-check on first use, and on OOM the batch is halved down to 1 before the existing behaviour takes over.

(2) GPU/CPU overlap and a scoring cascade. A producer thread keeps api_v2 busy while candidates are scored. I measured the precise 3-model judge on the 4-core dev CPU at 0.64 s per 5 s candidate, and running it in threads does not help. So a cheap pre-filter scores every candidate (duration sanity plus the fastest SV member, 0.14 s). Only the top 12 per sentence get the full ensemble and ASR.

The search uses a larger reference bank instead of the ~10 references. References are matched per sentence on type, length, English share and a measured prior from a reference audition on held-out val clips. Questions use the question reference only in the final chunk.

The ranking signals are:
- a consensus timbre term: the mean of the 3 models minus half their spread, capped at the teacher's own p90;
- a per-sentence expected-duration model;
- F0-shape features;
- a mixed zh/en CER: Paraformer for the Chinese characters, Whisper for the English words, counting only deletions and substitutions.

The ranking weights are calibrated against her held-out real recordings. The checkpoint is re-ranked under 「一模一样」 generation conditions, with a bootstrap test. If the top two are within noise, both stay as arms in a two-pass search per document; a v4 checkpoint joins only if training produces one.

The stopping rule is: at least 40 candidates, the strict targets met (her own median similarity, 0 wrong characters), and a plateau. Losing candidates in the top 4 are kept, so a redo keeps searching instead of starting over. Exact digital silence, the two variants and measured-only numbers stay as they are. 「一模一样」 becomes the default in the web UI, the CLI and old config files. Weaker machines keep it as the default with smaller caps and an honest note.

Timing numbers are estimates unless marked as measured on the dev machine. The program must measure and show the real per-sentence time after its first run.

changes.stage: 3/13. Reference pool: a reference bank instead of ~10 references
changes.change: Build refs_bank.json from all eligible teacher clips, with features. The trimmed WAV is written lazily the first time a reference is used. references.json and the other tiers stay untouched.
changes.params: Eligibility: keep, split train, not deleted, saved text (material confirmed), forced_cuts == 0, raw 3.0-11.0 s, ends_sentence (all question clips included). After trim_silence(pad 80 ms) the clip must be 3.2-9.8 s (api hard limit 3-10 s at 16 kHz, TTS.py 809-817). Features per clip: syllables, en_ratio (Latin syllables / all), kind, rate, duration, source, f0 median (prosody.f0_stats), precise-judge embeddings (cached .npz), self_pct against the centroid, base score references._score (L24-35). bank_sig = sha1(sorted id+text).
changes.why_more_alike: In GPT-SoVITS the main reference alone drives the GPT prompt (rate, pitch, style) and part of the timbre (_set_prompt_semantic TTS.py 781-817; ge per reference in models.py 995-1018). With ~10 references, 完美's length match picks among 2-7. A bank of hundreds of her own confirmed clips lets each sentence get a reference of the same type, similar length and similar English content. 559 of her 1004 lines contain English, yet today no reference is chosen for English content.
changes.code_plan: references.py: add build_reference_bank(project, records, judge) next to _select_references (L50-153); reuse its pool filter and trim. Bank WAVs go to references/bank/<id>.wav, written atomically (atomic.tmp_for / finish, as at L114-126). The bank is rebuilt when bank_sig or the manifest changes; old bank files are cleaned only during prepare (same rule as cleanup=True at L140-148).
changes.cost: Measured on the 4-core dev CPU: the 3-model judge takes 0.64 s per 5 s clip, so about 600 clips take about 6.5 min. This runs once per material change and is faster on a CPU with more cores (not measured on her PC). f0 is 20 ms per clip (measured). Disk: lazy, only the references actually used.
changes.risk: More reference variety can cause a style jump between adjacent sentences. The document-level tie-break (top-K change) and the judge mitigate this. Mixed-language prompt text gets English phones at inference while training stripped English (training-side gap). It still works, and gets better once the training-side front-end fix lands.
changes.test_without_gpu: On the dummy prepared project (tests/conftest fixtures): bank count, features, no file outside 3.2-9.8 s, lazy creation, bank_sig changes when a text edit is saved, references.json unchanged.

changes.stage: 3. Per-sentence reference matching (shortlist of R references)
changes.change: Score every bank reference for the sentence and pick R diverse references, replacing 完美's _ref_for for this tier.
changes.params: match = 1.2*[kind == seg kind (chunk-aware)] - 1.0*|ln((syl_ref+1)/(syl_seg+1))| - 1.5*|en_ref - en_seg| + 1.0*prior_z - 0.3*[pause > 0.9 s]. prior_z = z-score of the audition prior (reference-audition change), shrunk 50 % toward the z-scored base score; base score only when no audition exists. Exclude references whose normalized text equals the sentence. Greedy pick: best match, then the best from a different source within 1.0 of the top, and so on. If en_seg >= 0.15, at least one reference with en_ref >= 0.15 when one exists. R = 3 (low 2, cpu 2). A user-forced reference (UI) overrides everything, as today.
changes.why_more_alike: The GPT copies the reference's pace, pitch and intonation. Matching type, length (continuous instead of the 0.1-rounded bucket at engine L495-496) and English share gives the GPT a prompt closer to how she says this kind of sentence. Diversity lets the judge choose among genuinely different prompts.
changes.code_plan: New voicetwin/synth/search.py: shortlist_refs(seg, bank, prior, R). engine._ref_for L485-496 is kept for 完美.
changes.cost: Microseconds per sentence.
changes.risk: The weights are engineering values. They are only a shortlist, and the judge makes the final choice.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic banks: a question sentence gets a question reference; an English-heavy sentence gets an English-containing reference; diversity across sources; identical-text exclusion; forced reference respected.

changes.stage: 12/3. Reference audition (measured prior, run once per trained model)
changes.change: Generate held-out val sentences with the 24 best bank references and score each candidate against the teacher's REAL recording of the same sentence. The result becomes each reference's prior.
changes.params: 24 references (top by base score, max 3 per source) x 6 val items (excluding the reference clip itself) x 1 batched request (B=4, P0, aux 3). truth = to_real - 2*CER - 0.8*|ln(dur_gen/dur_real)|. to_real is the mean over members of cos(gen, real)/p50, as in select.py L94-97. prior = mean over items of the best-of-4 truth. Stored in models.json[gptsovits].identical.ref_prior with model_id and bank_sig.
changes.why_more_alike: The only ground truth available is her held-out recordings. A reference that makes the model reproduce her actual sentences more faithfully is likely the better prompt for new sentences. Today reference ranking is a hand-weighted proxy built on resemblyzer speaker_sim (references.py L24-35).
changes.code_plan: select.py: add audition_references(cfg, project, backend, sim, items, bank) reusing _Sim (L60-110), validation_items (exporters.py L69-71) and the batched synthesize_many. workflows.run_train L787-809 calls it after run_select when the resolved quality is identical. Narrator also runs it at first use if the entry is missing or stale.
changes.cost: Estimate: 144 requests / 576 candidates, about 3-6 min GPU (not measured on her PC). The full judge on 576 candidates is about 6 min at the dev-measured 0.64 s, overlapped. About 8-12 min in total, once per trained model.
changes.risk: 6 items per reference is a noisy estimate, so the prior enters only as one shrunk term. When val has fewer than 6 items, skip the audition and use the base score.
changes.test_without_gpu: Dummy backend plus the fake real api_v2: the request count equals refs x items, and stored priors are finite and z-scorable. With an empty val set the audition is skipped with a Chinese log line.

changes.stage: 5/8. Search: arms, sampling presets, aux, speed, successive halving
changes.change: Replace 完美's 'batches of 4, stop at the first pass' with an arm search. Phase 1 explores, phase 2 keeps the 2 best arms, phase 3 exploits the best arm. Extra arms are added only on measured need.
changes.params: P0 = {T 1.0, top_k 15, top_p 1.0} (abe9843 api_v2 default, L154-178). P1 = {T 1.0, top_k 5, top_p 1.0} (20250606v2pro api_v2 default, L157). P2 = {T 0.6, top_k 15, top_p 0.8} (existing RETRY_SAMPLING[1], engine L107; only after CER failures). repetition_penalty fixed at 1.35 (no evidence to move it, research_quality.md §8.10). Phase 1 arms: (r1,P0,aux3), (r2,P0,aux3), (r3,P0,aux3), (r1,P0,aux0), (r1,P1,aux3), (r2,P1,aux3); 1 request x B each, i.e. 24 candidates at B=4. arm_score = mean of the top-2 totals. Phase 2: top-2 arms, 2 requests each. Phase 3: best arm, 1 request at a time until stop. Extra arms: if no phase-1 candidate passes the CER gate, add (r1,P2,aux3) and (r2,P2,aux3). If median voiced_gen/expected_voiced of the survivors is off by more than 8 %, add (best ref, best preset, speed x clip(ratio, 0.9, 1.1)); speed only interpolates enc_p features (models.py 259-260). Aux set for main reference r: top-3 bank references by prior, same language, statement, other sources, 4-9.8 s. Seeds: request j uses base_seed + idx*7919 + j*104729; a candidate's id is (seed, row). Requests are ordered by (ref, aux) because the api recomputes the prompt cache only when the path or aux list changes (TTS.py 1123-1151).
changes.why_more_alike: 完美 reuses one reference for all tries and searches only seeds and 3 presets. Aux averaging affects timbre only (models.py 1009-1017) and its benefit was never measured on her voice (research_quality.md §8.11). Making the reference, the aux count and the official alternative top_k explicit arms lets the measured judge pick what is most like her for each sentence.
changes.code_plan: search.py: class IdenticalSearch(narrator) with run(seg, plan, force) -> (best, cands, tries, met, arms). engine.synthesize_segment L668: if self.quality == 'identical', delegate. The rest of that function (hints/status L781-803, meta write L812-824) is reused via a shared helper so reports stay identical in format.
changes.cost: Typical 40-52 candidates (11-14 requests) per sentence, cap 64. See the time estimates in the batching and pipelining changes.
changes.risk: More candidates bring more 'winner's curse' (the max of a noisy score). Mitigated by the consensus LCB, the cap at p90, the min/plateau stopping rule, and the honest note in the summary.
changes.test_without_gpu: Dummy backend (supports_aux_refs False, so aux arms collapse to one) and fake real api_v2: arms planned as specified; phase transitions; the P2 arm appears only after forced CER failures (fake CERChecker); the speed arm appears only when synthetic durations are off by more than 8 %; request ordering grouped by ref/aux; seeds unique.

changes.stage: 7. Batched candidates in ONE real api_v2 request (more candidates per GPU-second)
changes.change: New Backend.synthesize_many(req, n). GPT-SoVITS sends n copies of the sentence in one request and splits the answer back into n candidates. Every failure path falls back to n single requests.
changes.params: text = '\n'.join([t']*n), where t' gets the same '。'/'.' prefix pre_seg_text would add to a single request (TextPreprocessor.py 81-82). Batching is skipped if the text contains '\n', len > 400, or the VoiceTwin replica predicts != n fragments (merge rule threshold 5, L34-49). batch_size = n, parallel_infer True, text_split_method cut0, fragment_interval 0.5, speed_factor 1.0001 when the calibrated speed is exactly 1.0 (else the calibrated value). Split: _fix_int16_wrap on the whole answer, then exact-zero runs >= 0.6*0.5 s (v4 sizes the zeros with configs.sampling_rate); exactly n runs, the last ending at EOF, each piece >= 0.3 s and non-zero; else fall back. Each piece gets 0.3 s of zeros appended, the same bytes a single cut0 request returns. Starting B: high 12, mid 8, low 2, cpu 1. Auto-tune: the first 6 requests alternate B in {4, 8} (mid) and keep the higher measured candidates/s. OOM back-off: a silent 16 kHz answer whose log reason is OOM (gptsovits.py L1772-1781) means B = B//2 and the same request is retried; the session remembers max_ok_batch; at B=1 the existing fatal path applies (errors.FATAL_KEYS L76-79).
changes.why_more_alike: More candidates in the same time means a better best candidate. The GPT AR loop is batched with independent per-row sampling (abe9843 t2s_model.py 583-723, utils.py sample L192-199), so each row is an independent draw from the same distribution as a single request. With speed != 1.0 the VITS decodes each fragment separately (TTS.py 1262-1271, the same in tag 20250606v2pro). At exactly 1.0 it would decode all copies as ONE concatenated sequence (1236-1259), where enc_p attention mixes the copies; 1.0001 avoids that. At 1.0001, int(L/1.0001)+1 == L for every L in 1..9999 (checked), so F.interpolate gets the same size and the features are not resampled.
changes.code_plan: base.py: Backend.supports_batch=False; synthesize_many default loops synthesize with seed + k*104729 (dummy/qwen3/indextts unchanged). gptsovits.py: synthesize_many next to synthesize (L1729-1798), sharing the payload builder; _split_fragments (prototype: scratchpad/ymyy/search/split_proto.py); _batch_replica (prototype: scratchpad/ymyy/search/sim_batch_copies.py). On the first batched use per server start, a self-check sends the same seed with batch 1 at speed 1.0 and at 1.0001 and expects identical int16. If they differ, the 1.0001 trick is disabled and speed-1.0 sentences use single requests. Every split failure is logged in Chinese and counted in report.json.
changes.cost: Not measured on her PC. Estimate: one B=4 request for a 5 s sentence takes about 1.0-2.5 s, versus about 0.7-1.5 s for B=1 (the AR loop is latency-bound at batch 1), i.e. about 0.3-0.6 s of GPU per candidate instead of about 1 s. Memory estimate: KV cache about 48 KB/token/row (24 layers x 512 x fp16 x 2), about 40 MB per row; B=8 well under 1 GB.
changes.risk: The teacher's TTS.py is assumed to equal abe9843 (bundle v2pro-20250604); the self-check and strict split catch differences. Very short sentences (< 5 characters, e.g. '好的。') would merge, and the replica catches this: '好的。' -> 2 fragments -> single mode. An internal digital-silence run >= 0.3 s makes the split ambiguous and triggers the fallback. BERT is computed n times per request (small).
changes.test_without_gpu: Extend REAL_API_STUBS TTS.run (tests/fake_gptsovits.py L305-401): split the text on '\n' like pre_seg_text; produce one distinct sine per fragment (seeded by seed + row); append fragment_interval zeros per fragment; return a silent 16 kHz answer plus an OOM traceback when batch_size > FAKE_GSV_MAX_BATCH. Assert the recorded batch_size, the speed_factor 1.0001 rewrite, n lines, and n pieces back for both real api_v2 versions. Assert OOM halves B and recovers. Unit tests: splitter normal / ambiguous / short / 48 kHz cases (prototype output: normal OK, ambiguous -> None, wrong count -> None, 48 kHz OK); replica on all 1004 teacher lines (measured: 1004/1004 give exactly 4 identical fragments).

changes.stage: 8. Pipelined generation and scoring (keep the GPU busy)
changes.change: A producer thread sends the batched requests back to back (api_v2 runs them one at a time) into a bounded queue. The main thread scores candidates as they arrive. Stop decisions use scored results; in-flight results still join the pool.
changes.params: queue maxsize 2 requests; disabled on CPU-only machines (inference and scoring would compete for the same cores).
changes.why_more_alike: Today synthesis and scoring are strictly sequential (engine L703-730): the GPU sits idle during CPU judge scoring, which I measured at 0.64 s per 5 s candidate on the 4-core dev CPU. Overlapping gives more candidates in the same time.
changes.code_plan: search.py _Pipeline(backend, jobs) with threading.Thread plus queue.Queue. Both sides call _check_cancel (engine L60-64); TaskCancelled in either thread stops the other and removes temp files. requests.Session is used only by the producer thread.
changes.cost: None extra; hides scoring time behind GPU time.
changes.risk: Thread errors must surface with the existing Chinese reasons: the producer forwards the exception object through the queue.
changes.test_without_gpu: Dummy backend with an injected per-request delay and a scorer with an injected delay: wall time < sum of both. Cancellation mid-run stops both threads and leaves no tmp files. An exception in the producer is re-raised in the main thread with the same message.

changes.stage: 9/12. Cascade scoring with consensus and a cap at her natural range
changes.change: Two-stage scoring. A quick stage runs on every candidate; the full stage (all 3 judge models + F0 + ASR) runs on the top 12 per sentence. The timbre term becomes a consensus lower bound capped at her own p90. An optional local centroid is gated by val calibration.
changes.params: Quick stage: speech_activity (measured 2 ms); reject if voiced/expected outside [0.6, 1.6], a pause > 1.2 s, or near-silence; one fast member eres2net-base-zh (measured 142 ms per 5 s at 4 threads). Full stage for the top-12 by quick total: remaining members reuse the VAD-prepared speech (SimilarityJudge.embed_with_seconds L1035-1052), f0 (measured 20 ms), ASR. Timbre = min(mean(pct_raw_m) - 0.5*std(pct_raw_m), natural p90). Local centroid: the 12 bank clips nearest in (kind, en_ratio, length); local pct uses the same g50/i0; timbre = 0.5*global + 0.5*local only if the judge-weight calibration measures a gain, else global only. Displayed pct keeps today's definition (clamped 3-model mean).
changes.why_more_alike: Above her own p90 the judge cannot tell a candidate from her real recordings. Rewarding more 'centroid-ness' (pct_raw up to 150, metrics.py L321-322) favours an averaged timbre rather than her voice, so the cap lets prosody and accuracy decide among candidates that are already within her range. The cross-model spread is computed (judge_embeddings L1008-1029) but unused; requiring agreement reduces picking a candidate one model alone likes. The local centroid compares with how she sounds in similar sentences (e.g. English examples) instead of one global average.
changes.code_plan: search.py quick_score / full_score wrap Scorer.score (metrics.py L305-377) and add fields lcb, spread, local_pct, prosody_z, dur_dev to Score (L255-290, from_dict tolerant). speaker.py: add JudgeMember.pct_raw_against(emb, centroid) (next to pct_raw L807-817) and a SimilarityJudge.member(name) accessor.
changes.cost: Measured on the dev CPU: about 0.15 s per candidate (quick) plus 12 x about 0.5 s (rest of the full judge) per sentence, plus ASR on GPU (not measured). Roughly 13 s CPU per sentence at 48 candidates, overlapped with GPU.
changes.risk: The quick filter could drop the eventual winner. Mitigation: keep 12, and always fully score at least 1 candidate per arm. When the precise models are missing, the fallback judge (one-sided) runs without cap/LCB, exactly as today.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic embeddings and calibration dicts: cap applied, LCB math, the top-K selection keeps one per arm, the fallback path is unchanged. Score to_dict/from_dict round-trip with the new fields.

changes.stage: 6/11. Per-sentence expected duration (rate target)
changes.change: Fit her voiced duration as a function of the text instead of using one global rate. Use it in the quick filter, the total and the speed arm.
changes.params: voiced_s ~ a*n_cjk + b*en_syllables + c*n_digits + d*n_clause_punct (non-negative least squares over kept clips; R² and residual SD stored in profile.json). dur_dev = |ln(voiced_gen*speed/expected)|, weight 0.4 (same as score.rate today). Fallback to the global profile rate when there are fewer than 50 clips or R² < 0.3.
changes.why_more_alike: target_rate uses one median rate per language (metrics.py L327-333; mixed lines count as zh). 56 % of her lines mix in English, whose syllables she speaks at a different pace. A sentence-specific target rewards candidates paced like her for that content.
changes.code_plan: style/profile.py build_profile L28-107: add 'duration_model'. search.py uses it; metrics.Scorer is unchanged for other tiers.
changes.cost: Milliseconds once at prepare; negligible per candidate.
changes.risk: The heuristic English syllable counter (textutil.en_syllables) adds noise. The fit is reported, and the fallback covers bad fits.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic manifest generated from known coefficients is recovered within 5 %. Test project fits. A bad fit falls back.

changes.stage: 11/20. Prosody-shape features (intonation, declination, final movement)
changes.change: Measure per-candidate F0 shape and compare with her per-type distribution. The weight is set only by val calibration (default 0).
changes.params: F0 range p90-p10 (semitones), declination slope (semitones/s, linear fit over voiced frames), final movement (median F0 of the last 300 ms voiced minus the sentence median). Her distributions per kind come from at most 300 clips, cached in profile.json. prosody_z = mean |z|, capped at 3. w_pros in {0, 0.15, 0.3} from the judge-weight calibration.
changes.why_more_alike: Today only the median F0 and its std count, with tiny weights: a 2-semitone shift costs about 0.03, i.e. 1.7 similarity points. Question rise, declination and final drops are not measured at all (gap list stage 20).
changes.code_plan: style/prosody.py: add f0_contour(wav, sr) returning (times, f0) built from f0_track's frames (L13-35) and contour_stats(). profile.build_profile adds 'contour' per kind.
changes.cost: About 20 ms per fully scored candidate (same yin pass).
changes.risk: She has only 20 questions, so the question distribution is noisy; questions fall back to statement stats with a wider z. Chinese questions with 吗/呢 need not rise, which is why the weight comes only from measurement.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic rising/falling/flat tones give the expected signs; z-capping; the profile cache round-trip.

changes.stage: 12/19. Judge-weight calibration on her held-out real recordings
changes.change: Use candidates generated during checkpoint re-ranking (same 20 val items) to measure which proxy signals predict closeness to her real recording of the same sentence. Adopt non-default weights only with a cross-validated gain.
changes.params: truth = z(to_real) - z(F0-contour DTW RMSE, semitones, librosa.sequence.dtw on 10 ms frames) - z(|ln dur ratio|). Grid: w_local {0, 0.5}, w_rate {0.2, 0.4, 0.8}, w_pros {0, 0.15, 0.3}, cap {p90, none}. Objective: mean within-item Spearman(proxy total, truth), leave-one-item-out. Adopt only if the LOO gain is >= 0.05 over the defaults. Stored in models.json identical.weights with a version.
changes.why_more_alike: The ranking weights become measured on her voice instead of hand-set (default_config score L155-160). The ranking that best tracks closeness to her actual delivery wins.
changes.code_plan: New voicetwin/synth/calibrate_rank.py (pure numpy/scipy/librosa) called at the end of checkpoint re-ranking. search.py reads the weights and falls back to the defaults.
changes.cost: CPU only, about 1-2 min (DTW on about 480 short pairs; estimate). Reuses the re-ranking candidates.
changes.risk: 20 items is small: the shrink-to-default rule and the 0.05 margin prevent overfitting. Results are logged and written to research records.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic candidates whose truth is a known function of the features: the right weights are recovered. Pure-noise truth keeps the defaults. DTW on identical contours gives 0.

changes.stage: 10. Reading accuracy for mixed zh/en sentences
changes.change: Split the check: Paraformer for the Chinese characters, Whisper for the English words. Count only deletions and substitutions on each side. Tighter gates for this tier.
changes.params: Paraformer: compare CJK-only sequences (toneless pinyin as in cer_details L100-112), ignoring insertions (English often comes out as transliterated characters). Whisper (current model choice, language 'zh', no target-text prompt): align Latin word lists and count deletions + substitutions of reference words. errors = e_cjk + e_en; cer = errors/(n_cjk + n_en_words). Gate: strong 0 errors (min_wrong 2 rule kept) or cer <= 0.03; weak cer <= 0.06. Pure zh: Paraformer (unchanged). Pure en: Whisper en (unchanged). Only cascade survivors are checked.
changes.why_more_alike: Any Latin letter forces Whisper for the whole sentence (wants_paraformer L144-150). Whisper is noisier on Chinese (about 10 % vs about 2 % CER, research_quality.md §5), so mixed sentences either get false 'wrong character' flags (wasted tries) or missed Chinese omissions. Dropped words are the clearest 'not her' signal.
changes.code_plan: metrics.py: add CERChecker.check_mixed next to check (L232-250) and helper cer_split(); keep check() for other tiers. Engine strength rule unchanged (engine_is_strong).
changes.cost: Two ASR passes for mixed sentences on the top-12 only: about 12 x (0.1 + 0.3) s per sentence (estimate, GPU in the VoiceTwin process).
changes.risk: Insertions (repetitions) are not counted. They are caught by dur_dev and the long-pause/rate checks. When funasr is missing, Whisper alone is used as today.
changes.test_without_gpu: Fake transcriber objects: a transliteration insertion is not an error; a missing English word = 1 error; a missing Chinese character = 1 error; the Paraformer-missing path falls back.

changes.stage: 12. Strict targets and the stopping rule
changes.change: Do not stop at the first passing candidate. Search a minimum budget, then stop on targets plus a plateau, or at the cap.
changes.params: met = CER gate (mixed-CER change) and timbre pct >= effective_target(100), i.e. her own median, using natural_range like engine L574-582 (完美 uses p25), and in_normal_range and no issues. Stop when candidates >= 40 (low 16, cpu 6) and met and the best total improved < 0.02 (about 1 similarity point) over the last 8 candidates. Cap 64 (low 32, cpu 12). Give up early only if 2 requests returned nothing. Not met at the cap: best by (cer_ok, total) with the existing honest hint (_target_miss L584-593).
changes.why_more_alike: 完美 stops as soon as ANY candidate reaches her p25 (engine L746-749), usually after about 4 tries (not measured). 「一模一样」 keeps searching while improvements remain above noise.
changes.code_plan: search.py stop_rule(); thresholds in the identical preset (overridable via synth.tiers.identical as today, engine L333).
changes.cost: Part of the per-sentence budget above.
changes.risk: With the precise judge missing, the target falls back to 99 on the one-sided scale (engine L582), as today; the note says the judge is limited.
changes.test_without_gpu: Scripted score sequences: stops exactly at 40 with a plateau; continues when improving; respects the cap; gives up after 2 empty requests.

changes.stage: 19. Checkpoint re-ranking under 「一模一样」 conditions + speed recalibration (picking the best model)
changes.change: After the standard 4x3 selection, re-rank its top-3 checkpoints by running the actual identical mini-search on the 20 val items. Each picked output is judged against her real recording. Recalibrate speed from those outputs. Keep 2 checkpoints when they are within noise.
changes.params: Per checkpoint and item: 2 bank references (excluding the item's own clip and identical text) x B=4, aux 3, P0, chosen by the production judge (no ground truth), then scored by truth (judge-weight calibration) plus CER. Rank by mean truth. Paired bootstrap over items (1000 resamples): if the 90 % CI of top1-top2 includes 0, keep both as arms. speed_identical[lang] = clip(median voiced_gen/voiced_real, 0.8, 1.25), deadband 0.03 (rule of select.py L255-258), used only by this tier. A v4 checkpoint (only if the training side produced one) joins as a 4th contender.
changes.why_more_alike: Today selection uses one sample, seed 1234, no aux and pick_reference (select.py L195-200). Generation in this tier uses length-matched references, aux and best-of-many, so the checkpoint that wins after search may differ. Speed calibrated without aux drifts from the real rate (stage 6 gap).
changes.code_plan: select.py: add rerank_identical(cfg, project, backend, info) after select_and_calibrate (L123-271), storing models.json[gptsovits].identical = {ckpts, ranking, ci, speed, weights, ref_prior, run_stamp, model_ids}. workflows.run_train L787-809 calls it when the resolved quality is identical. The 'retrain-select' button and run_select (L875-894) take a flag that defaults to identical.
changes.cost: Estimate: 120 requests (480 candidates) plus 3 model switches: about 2-5 min GPU; the full judge on 480 candidates is about 5 min at the dev-measured rate, overlapped. About 6-10 min per trained model, on top of the existing selection (240 single syntheses).
changes.risk: 20 items still give a wide CI, which is why the tie keeps 2 checkpoints instead of guessing. If re-ranking fails, the standard selection stays in force (same pattern as the selection_error handling at L795-808).
changes.test_without_gpu: Dummy backend with fake checkpoints, plus the fake real api_v2 with real /set_*_weights (test_gsv_real_api.py L111-118): models.json fields written; the bootstrap function unit-tested; failure leaves the old selection.

changes.stage: 19/8. Model dimension in generation: two-pass per document (+ optional second resident server)
changes.change: If re-ranking kept 2 checkpoints (or a v4 exists), pass A runs the full search with checkpoint 1. Pass B runs 8 candidates per sentence with checkpoint 2 (the 2 best arms from pass A). Each sentence picks the best across both. Optionally, run pass B concurrently on a second api_v2 process.
changes.params: Pass B: 2 arms x 1 request x B=4. Only 2 weight switches per document (use_checkpoint, gptsovits.py L1716-1720). Second server: start only if nvidia-smi free VRAM (utils/gpu.py SMI_QUERY L39) after server 1 plus ASR is >= 2.5 GB AND a one-time measurement shows >= 15 % more candidates/s; otherwise sequential.
changes.why_more_alike: It hedges checkpoint-selection noise: the judge picks per sentence between two models that tie on val. Mixed sample rates (v4 48 kHz) are resampled to the max rate in _render (engine L1156-1166), and pauses stay exact zeros.
changes.code_plan: search.py run_document_pass_b(); candidate meta stores model_id; cache key includes both model ids. Second server: a second GPTSoVITSBackend instance on port+1 with its own log; stopped in finally.

changes.risk: The second server can OOM on 8 GB. It is gated, and on any failure it is stopped and the run continues single-server, with a Chinese log line.
changes.test_without_gpu: Dummy with 2 fake checkpoints: per-sentence choice across passes; model ids recorded; one checkpoint means no pass B. Fake api: the second server gate is mocked off/on, and teardown is verified.

changes.stage: 18. Keep the losing candidates (top-K), redo continues the search, document-level tie-breaks
changes.change: Store the top-4 candidates per sentence. Redo appends a new search (new seeds) that competes with the stored ones. After all sentences, near-ties are resolved for loudness and timbre consistency, without changing any gain.

Near-tie: Δtotal <= 0.02; prefer the candidate whose voiced-part LUFS is closest to the median of the chosen sentences, then the one whose embedding is closest to the document mean.

changes.risk: Stale candidates after a model change are invalidated by the model_id in the key.
changes.test_without_gpu: Dummy: redo never lowers the stored best total; judge-signature change re-ranks without synthesize calls; the tie-break picks the closer loudness; files cleaned by clear_cache (engine L1240-1245).

designs.training_side:
From the inference-search angle, 「一模一样」 does not need a new training mode. It does need these two hooks:

1. **Automatic step after training.** In run_train's auto-select (workflows.py L787-809), once the standard select_and_calibrate has finished, three steps run automatically whenever the resolved default quality is 「一模一样」 (which is now always, unless she locked another tier):
   - rerank_identical (checkpoint re-ranking under 「一模一样」 conditions, speed recalibration, keeping 2 checkpoints when they tie);
   - audition_references;
   - judge-weight calibration.

   The training page's 「重新挑选最佳模型」 button runs the same thing. If that step is missing or stale at generation time, the Narrator runs it first, with its own progress stage 准备「一模一样」. The teacher never has to trigger it herself.

2. **Requests to the training-side agents** (they own those changes):
   - Save weights every epoch. More checkpoints become possible arms, and disk is the only cost.
   - Keep at least 20 val clips; 40 would be better if they accept losing 2 % of the training data. Val is the only ground truth for the audition, the re-ranking and the weight calibration.
   - Fix the mixed zh/en training front end. Without it, the English-content reference matching still works, but the model's English is weaker.
   - If they add v4, write its checkpoints into models.json; the re-ranking and the two-pass generation then treat it as one more contender automatically.

A single-seed checkpoint pick is too noisy to trust, so the design keeps both checkpoints as generation arms instead of relying on one pick.
designs.honest_message:
老师，「一模一样」是我们努力的方向，不是保证。下面说清楚它会做什么、做不到什么。

它会做什么：
1. 从今以后，不论在网页上还是用命令行，默认都是「一模一样」。每次打开网页都会自动选好它。您改选别的档位，只对这一次有效，下次打开又会回到「一模一样」。
2. 第一次用某个训练好的模型时，程序会先拿您没参加训练的 20 句真实录音做「考试」，测三件事：
   - 哪个模型最像您；
   - 您的哪些录音拿来当参考最像您；
   - 打分时各项该看重多少。
   这一步只做一次。
3. 生成时每句话会：
   - 换几条和这句最接近的您的录音当参考（同样是问句或陈述句、长短接近、有没有英文）；
   - 试几种生成设置，让显卡一次同时生成好几个版本。显存够的电脑最多试 64 个版本，显存小于 8GB 的最多 32 个；
   - 用三个声纹模型、语音识别（中文、英文分开检查漏字错字）和您自己的语速、音调一起挑出最像您的那个。
4. 显卡一直满负荷工作。显存不够时，程序会自动减少每次同时生成的数量，不会因此出错停下。
5. 句子之间仍然是完全的数字静音，没有任何底噪。仍然同时做「未去杂音 / 去杂音」两个版本，并推荐更像您的那个。

做不到什么：
1. 不可能百分之百一样。它挑得再好，也不会超过模型训练出来的水平。
2. 机器打分不可能完全准确。而且「像你本人 %」是从很多个版本里挑出的最高分，会比真实水平偏高一点。最终请用耳朵听，「⑤ 鉴别」页可以做盲听测试。
3. 这个模型输出的声音最高只到 16 kHz（32 kHz 采样），非常细的高频细节会少一些。
4. 语音识别只能查出漏字、错字，查不出声调读错。
5. 句子开头的吸气声会被切掉。

需要多长时间（以下都是估计，还没有在您的电脑上实际测过）：
1. 第一次准备（每训练出一个新模型做一次）：大约 20～40 分钟。
2. 生成：每句大约 15～35 秒。一篇 10 分钟左右的讲稿（约 80 句）大约要 20～50 分钟，比「完美」慢 2～4 倍，但每句试的版本多 5～10 倍。
3. 显存小于 8GB：每句会少试一些版本，所用时间和上面差不多，也可能更长。
4. 没有 NVIDIA 显卡：仍然默认用「一模一样」，但用处理器生成可能要好几个小时。着急的话可以改选「均衡」。

第一次用完以后，程序会显示这次每句实际用了多少秒，以后就按这个真实速度估算剩下的时间。

designs.summary:
DATA AND MODEL design for 「一模一样」. All file:line references were checked against the repo and the official code fetched to scratchpad/ymyy (tag 20250606v2pro, and abe9843 for inference). I made no repo edits.

Biggest measured gap. Official 1-get-text.py (L86-103) runs clean_text(line,'zh') on the whole line, and chinese2.replace_punctuation then deletes every Latin letter. Inference does it differently: TextPreprocessor.get_phones_and_bert (abe9843 L122-195) splits the text with LangSegmenter, sends English to ARPAbet phones and gives it zero BERT. Of the teacher's 1004 kept lines, 559 (55.7 %) contain English: 2080 words, 6.1 % of all syllables. None of that English has ever been paired with English phonemes in training.

1. **New mixed-text 1A step (P1).** VoiceTwin runs its own 1A in the bundle's Python. It uses the official clean_text, LangSegmenter and roberta functions and copies the inference merge rule exactly. It checks itself against the official 1A and falls back to it if anything fails.
2. **Small data fixes.**
   - 112 clips end mid-sentence (measured). They get a final 「，」 instead of an added 「。」.
   - A read-only audit reports measured facts about the material.
   - Clips that went through denoising are re-rendered in place from the original video. Clip ids and the teacher's 138 corrected texts stay untouched; nothing is re-sliced.
   - The feature cache key (stamp) also covers the text front end and the audio files.
3. **Deep training (P2).** SoVITS 24 epochs saving every 2. GPT 20 epochs saving every 1 (the template default in s1longer-v2.yaml). When a bigger batch is used, epochs are scaled so the number of optimizer updates stays the same. DPO stays off.
4. **Measured batch probe.** It finds the largest batch that fits in dedicated VRAM. On Windows, running out of VRAM spills into shared memory and slows down instead of raising an error, so the probe watches peak memory and throughput as well as OOM. On a real OOM the batch steps down one at a time instead of a single halving. nvidia-smi is sampled during training, so GPU use is a measured number.
5. **Feature extraction in two parallel parts**, as the official webui does with GPU "0-0". After training, VoiceTwin counts how many clips were actually trained, from the files and the training logs.
6. **Training never repeats or skips silently.** It either starts fresh, extends the last run, or skips straight to selection. The teacher's current 30.6-minute model is kept and competes in the final selection.
7. **Deep checkpoint selection (P3).** It covers every saved checkpoint in three stages: GPT screen, SoVITS screen, final grid.
   - Test set: the same 20 held-out real clips (still the anchor for the similarity %) plus 24 built-in test sentences (questions, English examples, long sentences).
   - 2–3 seeds per sentence. The final stage uses the same reference choice, aux references and sampling as 一模一样 generation.
   - Score: calibrated similarity (pct_raw) + closeness to the real recording of the same sentence − CER − duration error − pitch-contour (F0, after DTW) mismatch with the real recording.
   - A failed synthesis counts as the worst score instead of being skipped. A bootstrap over sentences decides ties; the top 2 models go to generation as candidates.
   - Selection is cached and can resume, and CPU scoring overlaps with the next GPU synthesis.
8. **Optional V4 LoRA family.** Used only if its files and VRAM are present (or the files download), and only when measured as not worse on her recordings. The judge then picks per sentence. This follows permanent rule 11.
9. **References** are re-ranked with the precise similarity models, with 16 instead of 8 to choose from.
10. **Default everywhere.** 一模一样 is the default for both generation and training: web page load, CLI, config 'auto', and old config files (including the 'balanced' line written by v0.1.0–v0.1.3, handled like LEGACY_SAVE_EVERY). An explicit choice in config is respected. Weaker machines keep the default, never crash, and show an honest measured ETA.

**Rejected:**
- DPO: the community table says 8 GB cannot train it, it halves the batch and runs 2–4× slower, and the bundle predates the lost_P fix in PR #2733.
- Retraining on all 1004 clips after picking epochs: loses the held-out evidence and the calibration anchor.
- Enlarging the val set: changes the training set, which breaks the fair comparison with the old model and the calibration. Test sentences are added instead.
- A second training seed: doubles SoVITS time for an unknown gain and makes selection noisier.
- Re-slicing: would lose the 138 text repairs, which are keyed by clip id.
- Inserting commas at measured pauses: there is no word alignment, and it would change her confirmed text.
- Patching official scripts (s2 num_workers=5, the GPT LR locked at 0.002).
- V5: not public yet.

**Time (estimates; the 30.6-minute stage split is unknown):**
- v2ProPlus deep training about 55–75 min.
- Deep selection about 1.6–3.2 h.
- Optional V4 about 1.5–4.5 h more (training 50–160 min + selection 50–145 min).
- First full run about 3–5 h without V4, 5–9 h with it.

Every phase records its measured times, and later estimates use them. Research record: research/一模一样/记录.md, with scripts and results, per rule 2.

changes.stage: 9. Deep training plan (epochs, dense saving, CPU workers, disk check)
changes.change:
Training mode identical:
- SoVITS: 24 epochs at the batch-4 equivalent (official UI max is 25), save every 2, giving 12 checkpoints.
- GPT: 20 epochs, save every 1, giving 20 checkpoints. These are the template's own defaults (s1longer-v2.yaml: epochs 20, save_every_n_epoch 1).
- When the probe picks a batch b > 4, epochs = ceil(E·b/4), capped (SoVITS ≤ 48, GPT ≤ 50 = GPT_MAX_EPOCHS). Save intervals are re-fitted (_auto_save_every / _fit_explicit_save) to keep about 12 and 20 files. The total number of optimizer updates therefore equals the deep plan at batch 4: a bigger batch only fills the GPU, it does not change how much is learned. Note that GPT accumulates ×4 (t2s_lightning_module L41-56).
- text_low_lr_rate 0.4; official seeds 1234; DPO off.
- GPT data.num_workers = clamp(cpu_count−2, 2, 8) (s1 data_module L25, L58; s2's 5 workers are hard-coded and not patched).
- s2 log_interval 20, so ETA comes from measured steps.
- Disk: after the first saved SoVITS and GPT file, measure their sizes. If size × planned count exceeds shutil.disk_usage free space minus 2 GB, halve the save density and tell her the measured MB.
Explicit numbers in 高级设置 still win (USER_KEYS).
changes.why_more_alike: The standard epochs (12/15) are official defaults that were never measured on her voice. Studio-quality data tolerates longer SoVITS training (research_quality §4, M-confidence). The GPT LR is locked at 0.002 (lr_schedulers.py L38-62), so per-epoch checkpoints fluctuate; saving every epoch avoids missing the best one. Today SoVITS e8 and GPT e9 are saved but never evaluated. This is a hypothesis validated by measured selection on her recordings, not a promise: if late epochs are worse, an earlier checkpoint wins.
changes.code_plan: gptsovits.plan_training (L438) gets kw mode='identical'|'standard' and probe_batch=None. New constants: SOVITS_EPOCHS_DEEP=24, GPT_EPOCHS_DEEP=20, SOVITS_SAVE_DEEP=2, GPT_SAVE_DEEP=1, DEEP_MAX_SOVITS=48. The Chinese summary line explains each value (「一模一样训练：音色 24 轮、每 2 轮存一个；语气 20 轮、每轮存一个；训练完用你没参加训练的录音逐个比较」). _train_gpt (L1264) sets s1['data']['num_workers']. _train_sovits (L1230) sets s2['train']['log_interval']. New _disk_guard() is called from a poll hook after the first weight file appears.
changes.cost: Training time scales with epochs: SoVITS ≈ 2× and GPT ≈ 1.3× the standard stages. From the measured 30.6-min total, the deep v2ProPlus training is ≈ 55–75 min including features (estimate; the per-stage split of 30.6 min is only in the teacher's logs). Disk ≈ 3–6 GB per run (estimate; measured at runtime), and KEEP_OLD_RUNS=2 archives are also kept.
changes.risk: Late epochs may overfit; selection decides. Repetition or omission at many GPT epochs (#2508) is penalised by CER in selection. With b > 4 the SoVITS epoch count exceeds the official UI max of 25, but the update count does not; this is stated in the plan line.
changes.test_without_gpu: Pure tests of plan_training with the teacher's numbers (984 clips, ≥30 min, 7.96 GB total, 6.8 free): identical gives bs 4, SoVITS 24/save 2, GPT 20/save 1, DPO off; probe_batch 6 gives SoVITS 36 and GPT 30 with re-fitted saves; explicit user epochs win. Disk guard with a tmp folder and a monkeypatched disk_usage.
changes.params: SoVITS 24 ep / save 2; GPT 20 ep / save 1; update-matched scaling ceil(E·b/4); caps 48/50; GPT num_workers clamp(cpu−2,2,8); disk margin 2 GB

changes.stage: 9. Batch probe (largest batch that really fits) and OOM ladder
changes.change:
Before the real run, probe batches by running the OFFICIAL training script for about 40 steps on a probe subset: the 128 longest train clips, which is the worst-case bucket. The probe uses its own exp dir logs/<exp>_probe built from hard links, if_save_every_weights False, save interval 9999, and log_interval 2. It polls nvidia-smi memory.used and utilization.gpu every 1 s.
- SoVITS candidates {4,5,6,8}, capped by N/4. GPT candidates {4,6,8,12}, capped by N/4 (the data_module L51 cap).
- Pick the batch with the highest measured samples/s whose peak memory.used ≤ total − 0.3 GB, with no OOM in the log and throughput ≥ 1.05× the previous candidate. Stop at the first OOM or spill.
- On Windows the driver's sysmem fallback turns overflow into a large slowdown instead of an OOM (already noted in plan_training). Spill is therefore detected from peak ≈ total or a throughput drop, never assumed from 'no error'.
- Real run: an OOM steps the batch down one at a time (bs → bs−1 → … → official formula → 1; at most 3 retries) instead of _with_oom_retry's single halving (L1209-1228). For v4, grad_ckpt=True is the last step.
- During the real training, nvidia-smi is sampled every 5 s into params['gpu_peak_gb'] and params['gpu_util_avg'] (measured), shown as 「显卡平均使用率 xx%」. If the average is below 70 %, it states honestly that the CPU and data loading are the limit.
- If the probe itself fails, fall back to today's formula (vram_batch).
changes.why_more_alike: Honest note: batch size is throughput, not similarity. It makes the GPU do more learning per hour, and the saved time is spent on more epochs and deeper selection. It satisfies the teacher's 'use the full GPU' demand without risking a crash or a 5× slowdown from Windows VRAM spill.
changes.code_plan: base.run_logged (L230): new optional stop_when(line)->bool (kill the process tree and return normally) and on_poll() hook. utils/gpu.py: smi_sample() using SMI_QUERY (L39) plus utilization.gpu. gptsovits: _probe_batch(kind, candidates) builds the probe s2/s1 config from the same templates as _train_sovits/_train_gpt, parses 'Train Epoch' timestamps (s2) and Lightning it/s (s1), and stores params['batch_probe'] = [{bs, samples_per_s, peak_gb, ok, why}] (measured). Replace _with_oom_retry with _oom_ladder. Skip the probe when the user typed a batch.
changes.cost: ≈ 6–12 min in total (estimate: about 60–90 s per candidate including model load).
changes.risk: Probe memory can differ from a full run; longest clips and a 0.3 GB margin reduce this, and the ladder catches the rest. If a desktop app grabs VRAM later, the ladder plus resume handles it. No weights are saved by the probe.
changes.test_without_gpu: fake_gptsovits: keep FAKE_GSV_OOM_ABOVE and add FAKE_GSV_SLOW_ABOVE=N (prints lower it/s above N). Monkeypatch smi_sample to report rising memory. Assert the chosen batch, that stop_when kills the fake trainer, and that no weight files appear. Ladder test: OOM above 5 with plan 6 gives a successful retry at 5 and params records batch_size_used=5.
changes.params: SoVITS {4,5,6,8}, GPT {4,6,8,12}; margin 0.3 GB; gain threshold 1.05×; ladder max 3; smi poll 1 s probe / 5 s training

changes.stage: 10. Run semantics: fresh, extend or skip; keep the old model as a competitor
changes.change:
Deep mode chooses explicitly:
- (a) material, front end or audio changed → fresh run, archive as now (_archive_old_run L1063).
- (b) unchanged and the last run planned fewer epochs → extend by resuming to the deep epochs. s2_train resumes from G/D and rebuilds ExponentialLR (s2_train.py L188-207, L259); s1 resumes from logs_s1_<ver>/ckpt. The old checkpoints e2..e12 stay candidates (same RUN_STAMP, _pick_run L677).
- (c) already deep-trained with the same plan → skip training, run the deep selection, and say 「素材没变、已经按一模一样练过了，这次直接重新挑选」.
Before a fresh run, store models.json['previous_selected']. It holds the archived paths after _repoint_models (L1040) plus its last selection numbers, so the final selection can compare it.
changes.why_more_alike: Today 'train again with the same epochs' trains nothing, and 'more epochs' silently continues. Explicit handling guarantees deep mode really learns more. Keeping the teacher's current 30.6-minute model in the final comparison means the program never switches to a model that is measurably worse on her recordings.
changes.code_plan: gptsovits.train (L1294): decide the state from voicetwin_list.sha1 and the front-end sidecar plus models.json params (mode, epochs). params['mode']='identical'. Record previous_selected before _prepare_features archives. The archive pruning already protects the selected model's run; extend that protection to previous_selected until the deep selection finishes.
changes.cost: None extra. Extending saves the time of the already-trained epochs (measured: the first 12 SoVITS / 15 GPT epochs).

designs.training_side:
Yes. 「一模一样」 needs a training mode, 「一模一样训练」, and that mode is the default.

**How she triggers it:** On ② 训练模型 there is a new radio 「训练方式」 with two choices: 一模一样（默认） and 标准（约 30 分钟，以前的做法）. It resets to 一模一样 every time the page loads. She just clicks 「开始训练」. 「重新挑选最佳模型」 also runs the deep selection by default, following the same radio. 高级设置 keeps manual epochs and batch (explicit numbers still win, as with USER_KEYS today) and adds a checkbox 「也训练 V4 模型来比较（更慢）」, on by default in 一模一样. It is skipped automatically with a Chinese reason if files, the peft package or VRAM are missing, or if the download fails.

**CLI:** `voicetwin train` and `voicetwin select` default to `--mode identical`. `--mode standard` and `--no-v4` are explicit choices.

**Config:** backends.gptsovits.train.mode: auto, where auto means identical. Old config.yaml files have no such key, so they also mean identical.

**What happens to her existing model:** The first 一模一样 training is a fresh run, because the text front end changes and English is now trained. The old 30.6-minute model is archived, never deleted while it is the selected model, and competes in the final selection. If the new model is not measurably better on her 20 held-out recordings, the old one stays selected.

**Later runs on unchanged material:** They extend the existing run instead of starting again (old checkpoints stay candidates). If the material is already deep-trained with the same plan, the program skips training and goes straight to the deep selection, and says so.

**Time (estimates):**
- v2ProPlus deep training about 1–1¼ h.
- Deep selection about 1.6–3.2 h.
- With V4, about 1.5–4.5 h more.

After her first run, the program measures these times on her PC and shows them.
designs.honest_message:
老师您好，「一模一样」这一档，我按"从头到尾每一步都尽最大努力"来设计。它是以后每次的默认档，您不用选；只有您自己在网页上换成别的档位，才会改。下面说清楚它会做什么、要多久、做不到什么。

一、它会做什么（都用您自己的录音来检验）
1. 让英文例句真正参加训练：您 1004 句素材里，有 559 句带英文（一共 2080 个英文单词）。以前训练时，这些英文部分被 GPT-SoVITS 官方的处理步骤整个丢掉了，模型没学过您说英文的声音。这次改成和生成时同样的处理方法，英文也参加训练。新方法如果在您电脑上出问题，会自动退回官方的方法，并告诉您原因。
2. 练得更久，多存版本：音色模型练 24 轮、每 2 轮存一个；语气模型练 20 轮、每轮存一个（以前是 12 轮和 15 轮）。练得多不一定更好，所以每个存下来的版本都会拿来比较。
3. 用您没参加训练的 20 句真实录音，加上 24 句检查用的句子（问句、带英文的句子、长句），把每个版本都试一遍。每句试 2～3 次，用和真正生成时一样的方法来生成。比较的项目有：
   - 像不像您（三个声纹模型一起打分）；
   - 和您本人读同一句话像不像；
   - 有没有漏字、错字；
   - 快慢和音调走向像不像。
   最后选出最像您的那个版本。差不多一样好的两个都留着，生成时每句再挑一次。您现在的旧模型也一起参加比较；新模型如果实测不比旧的好，就继续用旧的。
4. 尽量用满显卡：先实测您的显卡最多能一次练几条，练的时候记下显卡的实际使用率，跑满时显示给您看。显存不够时自动一步一步减少，不会让程序崩溃。
5. 如果能拿到 GPT-SoVITS V4 的模型文件，还会多练一个 V4 模型，用同样的方法和 v2ProPlus 比较。只有实测不比 v2ProPlus 差，才会用它。拿不到文件、显存不够、下载失败时，就自动跳过，并告诉您原因。

二、要多久（都是估计）
第一次全部做完，大约 3～5 小时；加上 V4，大约 5～9 小时。其中：
- 训练大约 1～1¼ 小时（V4 另外加 1～2½ 小时）；
- 挑选最像的版本大约 1.6～3.2 小时（V4 另外加 1～2½ 小时）。
这些是估计。第一次做完以后，程序会记下您电脑上实际用的时间，以后显示的就是实测的。中途停下了，下次会从停下的地方接着做。显存小或者没有能用的 N 卡的电脑也照样是这个档，不会崩溃，只是会慢很多：程序会先按实际速度告诉您大约要多少小时，您可以自己决定换不换。

三、做不到的地方（必须如实告诉您）
1. 不能保证 100% 一模一样。没有任何声音克隆程序能做到；「一模一样」是努力的方向，不是保证。
2. 最高能有多像，取决于您的录音素材：录音里没有的说话方式（比如很激动的语气），模型学不会。
3. 「像你本人 %」是机器打分，按您自己的真实录音来校准。它听不到很高的高音部分，也不是绝对准。最终请用耳朵判断，或者用「⑤ 鉴别」做盲听测试。
4. 页面上显示的百分比、条数、时间都是在您电脑上实际测出来的；没测过的就写「估计」。句子之间仍然是完全的数字静音，不加任何底噪。

designs.summary:
PERCEPTION AND JUDGE design for the 「一模一样」 tier (internal key "twin"). Main idea: make the judge score the things listeners actually use to say "that is exactly her", measure each of them from HER recordings, and use the same measurement on her recordings and on the output.

The chain has seven steps:
(1) A one-time TwinProfile measures her habits from the existing clips and the cleaned full sources that prepare already keeps (raw/<sid>.wav, prepare.py:516). It never re-slices and does not touch her 138 text corrections. It measures: pauses at each kind of punctuation, F0 level, range, declination and sentence-final contour, rate as a function of sentence length, sentence-to-sentence loudness spread, long-term spectrum (LTAS) up to 16 kHz, onset/offset decay, and the deltas between neighbouring sentences.
(2) A twin judge adds new terms on top of the calibrated SV ensemble: a saturating, agreement-robust timbre term, prosody / rhythm / LTAS likelihood terms (z-scores against her distributions), and stronger accuracy checks for mixed zh/en lines.
(3) Search levers that come from perception: context-matched references used as a candidate dimension; a same-seed speed refinement (the seed is set before GPT sampling and speed only enters the SoVITS decode, TTS.py L1054 / L1305-1333); a stop rule aware of judge noise.
(4) The top 6 candidates of each sentence are kept, and a Viterbi pass chooses the most consistent path over the whole lecture.
(5) Assembly uses her measured pause lengths. Pauses go through measure-and-correct with the same detector that measured her pauses, so the output is still exact zeros. Each sentence gets one constant gain to match her loudness spread. A capped match EQ is applied only if the judge accepts it.
(6) Checkpoint selection uses the same twin judge under generation conditions, against her same-sentence real recordings.
(7) Optional: her own A/B picks re-weight the judge.

Evidence I gathered:
- Real teacher text, in the repo: 283 of 1004 kept lines contain 334 sentence ends inside a clip. profile.py:55-57 currently drops their pauses. There are 1741 clause marks, which are the measurable comma-pause points. English share per line: 445 lines with none, 338 under 10%, 188 at 10-30%, 33 at 30% or more. Sentence kinds: 984 statements, 20 questions, 0 exclamations.
- Simulation (not her data; script scratchpad/ymyy/perc/gap_bias_sim.py): the current profile's sentence-gap median comes out 0.550 s against a true 0.418 s (+32%), because the slicer joins gaps of 0.5 s or less. Re-measuring gaps on the full source gives 0.440 s. On the output side, the measured gap is the requested pause + 0.03 s.
- Dev-machine timings (4 cores, scratchpad/ymyy/perc/time_features.py and search/time_judge.py): per 5 s candidate, F0 features take 21 ms, LTAS 4 ms and pause detection 2 ms. Viterbi over 300 sentences x 6 candidates takes 3 ms. The existing precise SV judge takes 0.74 s.

All new knobs live in QUALITY_PRESETS['twin'] and its cache signature. Every new term falls back to 完美's behaviour, with a Chinese note, if a measurement or model is missing. The pieces are testable on the dummy worker, which already produces 0.22 s comma pauses, declination, a question-final rise and seeded jitter, and on the fake/real api_v2 harness.

Overall time: a 10-minute lecture (about 100 sentences, 16-40 tries each, 1-3 s per synthesis plus about 0.7-1.5 s judge, partly overlapped) is an estimate of 1-4 hours. The program measures seconds per try live and shows the remaining time.

changes.stage: Prepare → profile (new: measure HER habits)
changes.change:
New module voicetwin/style/twin_profile.py with build_twin_profile(project), which writes workspace/<voice>/twin_profile.json. Sub-parts a-f:
(a) Pauses: re-measured on the cleaned full sources raw/<sid>.wav, using the slicer's own detector with the minimum silent run lowered from 300 ms to 120 ms. Each clip's inner pauses (with their time positions) and its exact gap_after are taken from the source timeline using the clip's start/end. Inner pauses are aligned to the clip's punctuation marks by DP (Needleman-Wunsch). The expected position of a mark is (syllables before the mark) / (all syllables), over voiced time. Skip cost is 0.08 for a pause with no mark and 0.08 for a mark with no pause; a match is accepted when |Δfrac| <= 0.12. The output has quantiles p05..p95, n, and P(pause | mark) for these classes: ，/, 、, ：；, sentence end inside a clip, clip-final sentence gap, and hesitation pauses (count per 100 syllables plus durations).
(b) Per-sentence prosody features, from clips that end a sentence and have no forced cuts: F0 median in semitones relative to her global median, F0 range p90-p10 (st), declination slope (st/s, linear fit over voiced frames), final slope (last 300 ms voiced, st/s), energy range (dB p90-p10 over voiced frames), and the fit log(rate) = a + b·log(syllables) with its residual σ. Groups are kind {statement, question} x English share {<10%, 10-30%, >=30%}.
(c) Loudness: speech-only loudness of each clip minus its source median, giving σ and p05/p95.
(d) LTAS: 22 one-third-octave bands from 100 Hz to 12.7 kHz, computed on her clips resampled to 32 kHz (the generator's rate): per-band mean and per-clip SD.
(e) Edges: onset rise time, offset decay time (from 30 dB below peak down to the floor or to zero), and the fraction of clips with a breath before the onset.
(f) Consecutive-unit deltas within the same source when the gap is under 2 s: ΔF0 median, Δloudness and Δlog rate, at sentence level and at phrase level (clips split at their aligned comma pauses).
changes.why_more_alike: Listeners recognise a lecturer by habits: how long she pauses at commas and full stops, her melody, her tempo and her loudness. Today build_profile (profile.py L42-74) only sees pauses at clip boundaries. The slicer merges gaps of 0.5 s or less into clips (slicer.py find_segments join rule), so the sentence pause is biased upward: +32% in simulation (0.550 vs 0.418 s). It also throws away the 334 sentence ends inside clips. Pitch is only one median plus one std over clip medians (L76-91), there is no contour, no loudness spread and no spectrum. Every later stage needs these measured targets.

changes.change:
New TwinScorer in voicetwin/eval/twin_judge.py (it subclasses Scorer).

- Twin gate: the mean is at least her natural p25 for the segment's group, AND every member's own pct is at least that member's natural p10.
- English-heavy group: a separate natural range is calibrated on her 33 lines that are 30% or more English, after excluding them from the centroid.

changes.why_more_alike: Today the ranking maximises pct_raw up to 150 (metrics.py L326), which rewards being 'more central than her own median clip'. That can favour an averaged, flatter timbre. Above her median the judge's per-clip noise (3-6 points SD, measured in §10) dominates. So above 100% the decision should move to directly measured cues. Using mean minus spread punishes candidates that fool only one model; today the spread is computed (speaker.py L1027) but never used.
