changes.stage: Judge: melody (pitch level, range, declination, sentence-final contour)
changes.change:
Prosody likelihood term: P = −0.06 · mean_f min(z_f², 9). The features f are F0 median (st vs her global median), F0 range, declination slope, final slope and energy range. The z-scores are against her TwinProfile group (kind x English share).
- Twin gate: |z| <= 2 for every feature.
- Chinese issues carry measured numbers, e.g. 「语调比你平时平（起伏 2.1 半音，你平时 3.4 半音）」.
- It replaces pitch_dev (metrics.py L357-366) and in_normal_range (L379-390) for twin only.
changes.why_more_alike: Melody is what makes a voice sound like a particular person, beyond timbre. With today's weights a 2-semitone shift in median pitch costs about 0.033, i.e. about 1.7 similarity points, so prosody barely moves the choice. Contour, range and a question's ending are never measured. The weight 0.06 is set so that being 1 SD off on every feature costs 3 pct points, which is about the SV judge's own per-clip noise.
changes.code_plan: twin_judge.prosody_features(wav, sr) shares the F0 code with TwinProfile. The z-scores use the group statistics, falling back to statement/all when n < 8. Twin issues/hints go through engine _target_miss (L584-593).
changes.cost: Measured 21 ms per 5 s candidate on the dev machine.
changes.risk: Creaky voice / octave errors are handled by robust percentiles and the octave filter. The weights are engineering values; this is said honestly in the records, and they can be adjusted by her picks (change 18).
changes.test_without_gpu:
The dummy worker produces declination 1.08→0.92 and a 1.25x question rise (dummy_worker.py L63-65). Build the profile from dummy material.
- A candidate with f0 180 instead of 150 gets a large |z|.
- A question without the rise (monkeypatched synth_speech) scores below one with the rise.
- Missing profile → behaves like 完美.
changes.params: w_prosody 0.06; z clip 3; gate |z| <= 2; group fallback n < 8

changes.stage: Judge: tempo and rhythm (rate, where and how long she pauses inside a sentence)
changes.change:
Rhythm term R = −0.06 · mean(min(z², 9)), built from these z-scores:
- Rate: z_rate = log(rate / target) / σ_resid, with target = exp(a + b·log(syllables)) · user speed multiplier, from her length-conditioned fit.
- Comma pauses: their count against her expected Σ P(pause | mark) for this text's marks, and their log-duration against her comma distribution.
- Hesitation pauses: their count against her measured rate.
The long-pause issue threshold becomes her p97 inner pause instead of the fixed 1.2 s.
changes.why_more_alike: Tempo and pause placement are among the strongest identity cues for a lecturer. Today the target is one global p50 per language (metrics.py L337-346), and internal pauses are only checked above 1.2 s (L348). A longer sentence spoken at the same speed as a short one, or a missing comma pause, sounds 'not her'.
changes.code_plan:
- Add utils/audio.speech_runs(wav, sr) → [(start, end)]; speech_activity (L182-209) returns only durations.
- twin_judge.rhythm(wav, sr, text, lang, mult) reuses align_pauses from change 1.
- Register it in TwinScorer.
changes.cost: Measured about 2 ms per candidate (speech_activity); the DP takes microseconds.
changes.risk: English rate inside mixed lines is not separable; the mixed groups of the fit are used. If the fit has n < 20, it falls back to the p50 rate (today's behaviour).
changes.test_without_gpu:
Dummy material gives comma pauses of 0.22 s.
- A candidate with its comma pause removed (monkeypatched) gets a lower R.
- A synthetic record set with a known a/b recovers a/b within 5%.
- Long-pause threshold test.
changes.params: w_rhythm 0.06; z clip 3; rate fit per group (needs n >= 20); long-pause threshold = her p97

changes.stage: Judge: brightness / spectrum above 8 kHz
changes.change: LTAS term S = −0.04 · mean_b min(z_b², 9) over the 22 bands. Each z is against her per-band mean, using her per-clip SD. The input is the 32 kHz candidate, analysis frames above the 30th energy percentile, level-normalised. It is reported as 「声音亮度（高频）」 with measured dB differences.
changes.why_more_alike: The SV judge works at 16 kHz with fbank up to 8 kHz (sv_frontend SR 16000), so it cannot see air, sibilance or spectral tilt between 8 and 16 kHz, where vocoder dullness or denoise damage shows. Spectral tilt is a big part of 'that is her voice on her microphone'.
changes.code_plan: twin_judge.ltas_bands(wav, sr): scipy.signal.stft with 1024/320, band averaging. The same function is used in TwinProfile (change 1 d), the variant recommendation (change 16) and the match EQ check (change 15).
changes.cost: Measured 4 ms per 5 s candidate on the dev machine.
changes.risk: Phonetic content changes a sentence's LTAS, which is why the per-clip SD normalisation is used. 32 kHz output limits the analysis to 16 kHz; that is inherent to v2ProPlus and stated honestly.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic: a copy of a dummy candidate low-passed at 6 kHz gets a lower S than the original; a ±10 dB level change leaves S unchanged.
changes.params: w_ltas 0.04; bands 100 Hz-12.7 kHz (one-third octave); frames above the 30th energy percentile

changes.stage: Judge: reading accuracy for mixed Chinese/English and tones; correct text_lang
changes.change:
(a) Lines that contain both CJK and Latin are checked twice:
- Paraformer (the strong Chinese engine) for the CJK part, comparing CJK-only units after stripping Latin from both reference and hypothesis;
- faster-whisper large-v3-turbo for the Latin words, compared word by word.
The two are combined as errors / units.
(b) Tone-aware secondary check: pypinyin Style.TONE3, counting tone-only mismatches. Ignore set: 的地得了着吗嘛呢啊. Penalty −0.3 · tone_err_rate; it is never a gate.
(c) text_lang: send 'zh' whenever the segment has any CJK character; keep 'en' only for pure English.
changes.why_more_alike:
A dropped or mispronounced word is the fastest giveaway.
- Today any Latin letter forces Whisper (wants_paraformer, metrics.py L144-150), which is noisier on Chinese; that affects 56% of her lines.
- detect_lang (textutil.py L29-35) routes '比如 This is a very long English example…' to 'en'. GPT-SoVITS English g2p then silently drops the CJK words (english.py replace_phs), and the per-Latin-character CER barely notices.
- Tone errors pass today's toneless pinyin comparison.
changes.code_plan:
- metrics.py: CERChecker.check (L232-250) gets mode='split' for twin. cer_details (L100-112) gets a tones=True variant.
- engine.py: attempt (L691-698) passes lang_send = 'zh' if count_cjk(seg.text) else seg.lang. The fix is in the engine, and gptsovits.py L1741 maps anything other than 'en' to zh, so the backend needs no change.
- The tone penalty is added in TwinScorer.
changes.cost: One extra Paraformer pass per mixed candidate: estimate 0.1-0.3 s on her GPU (not measured). The tone check takes microseconds.
changes.risk: Whisper may translate instead of transcribing, so only Latin-word comparisons count from it. Paraformer missing → today's behaviour. Tone false positives → small weight plus the ignore set.
changes.test_without_gpu:
- Fake checkers (monkeypatched _load / _load_paraformer) with fixed hypotheses: a mixed line with one missing CJK word must fail the gate.
- tests/test_gsv_real_api.py harness: a mixed line with 2 CJK characters and a long English sentence is recorded with text_lang 'zh' in _real_api_calls.jsonl.
- Tone-only mismatch on 是/时 → penalty; 的/得 → none.
changes.params: tone weight 0.3 (not a gate); cer_target strong 0.03 / weak 0.06; cer_retry strong 0.08 / weak 0.12

changes.stage: Reference audio: matched to the sentence's context and treated as a candidate dimension
changes.why_more_alike: In GPT-SoVITS the main reference alone drives the GPT prompt (TTS.py _set_prompt_semantic), i.e. rate, pitch, energy and style. Today all up to 20 tries reuse one reference (engine _ref_for L485-496), so the search never explores the most important prosody lever. Paragraph-initial references match her pitch reset, and paragraph-final ones match her falling ends. English-heavy references prime her English. Today every chunk of a long question also gets the question reference (script.py L320), including non-final chunks, which she does not say with a question contour.
changes.code_plan:
- references.py: new select_twin_pool(project, records, n=32) reusing the eligibility rules of _select_references (L50-153), trimmed to 3.2-9.8 s (api_v2 requires 3-10 s, TTS.py L809-817). Writes references_twin.json + references/twin/.
- engine.py: new _ref_candidates(seg). _plan (L504-514) keys the cache on the pool ids. attempt (L691-698) takes the reference and aux per try.
- script.py: parse_script sets seg.extra['final_chunk'].
- If the pool is unavailable, fall back to _ref_for.
changes.cost:
Pool build, one time and cached: precise embeddings of the top 200 clips pre-ranked by _score, at 0.74 s each (measured on the dev machine), about 2.5 min.
Per switch: api_v2 recomputes the prompt features only when the reference path changes; a small GPU cost, not measured.
changes.risk: A wrong reference transcript would leak into the output, so only the saved, confirmed manifest text is used, forced cuts are excluded, and the clip must end a sentence. A reference with a bad stats history is only deprioritised, never banned.
changes.test_without_gpu:
- Prepared project: pool size and tags are correct.
- Dummy narration: the report shows at least 2 distinct ref ids among the tries of a sentence.
- A non-final chunk of a long question gets a statement reference.
- Fake api_v2 jsonl shows ref_audio_path rotation and aux_ref_audio_paths alternating between [] and 3 paths.
changes.params: pool 32; R 4 per sentence; halving after 8 tries; aux {0, 3}; shrinkage k 5

changes.stage: Tempo refinement with the same seed (exact rate without losing the chosen take)
changes.change:
For the best candidate, and also the runner-up if it is within 0.02: if |log(rate_obs / target)| > max(0.03, 0.5·σ_resid), synthesise again with exactly the same text, seed, reference, aux and sampling, and only speed changed.
- new_speed = speed × target / rate_obs, with the ratio clipped to [0.88, 1.12] and the final value to 0.5-2.0.
- Token-identity check: if |voiced_new · new_speed / speed − voiced_old| / voiced_old <= 4%, tag it 'refined'; otherwise treat it as an ordinary candidate.
Both versions are judged and the better one is kept.
changes.why_more_alike:
Her tempo depends on the sentence. Today speed is one global factor per language, measured on 20 single-seed items with no aux (select.py L255-258).
In api_v2, set_seed runs at the start of every request (TTS.py L1054, L194-214), before GPT sampling (infer_panel L1270-1280). speed_factor only enters the SoVITS decode (TTS.py L1305-1333; models.py decode L995+). So the same seed should keep the same words and intonation, with the tempo corrected.
changes.code_plan: engine.py synthesize_segment (L668-830): after selection, a twin-only refine step reuses attempt() with a forced seed and speed. SynthRequest (base.py L51-63) already carries every field needed. The new candidate is added to cands before final selection.
changes.cost: At most 2 extra syntheses per sentence: estimate 1-3 s each on her GPU, not measured.
changes.risk: cuDNN non-determinism may change the tokens; the duration check catches that, and the result simply becomes one more candidate. VITS noise (noise_scale 0.5) differs with length, giving a small timbre change that is judged anyway.
changes.test_without_gpu:
- Fake api_v2: the refinement request differs ONLY in speed_factor (same seed, text, ref, aux, top_k / top_p / temperature) in _real_api_calls.jsonl.
- Dummy backend (speed scales syllable durations, dummy_worker.py L56-60): the refined candidate's rate is within 3% of the target.
changes.params: trigger max(3%, 0.5·σ_resid); step limit ±12%; identity tolerance 4%

changes.stage: Candidate loop: stop rule and tie-breaking that respect the judge's noise
changes.change:
Twin branch of the adaptive loop:
- Always try at least min_candidates (16), even if targets are met.
- Then stop when the targets are met AND the best twin total has not improved by more than 0.02 (worth 1 pct point) in the last 8 tries. Otherwise continue to the cap: 40, or 20 on low VRAM, or 12 on CPU. The final counts are to be set by the GPU/search design.
- Final pick: among candidates in the best gate class within 0.02 of the maximum total, choose the best NON-SV part (prosody + rhythm + LTAS + accuracy).
changes.why_more_alike: 完美 stops at the first batch where any candidate meets targets (engine.py L744-747), usually after 4 tries. With many candidates, the maximum of noisy SV scores selects judge noise (winner's curse). Breaking near-ties with directly measured cues picks the candidate that is actually more like her.
changes.code_plan: engine.py: adaptive loop L734-750 (twin branch), _select L554-565 (twin tie-break), _desc L838-843, progress messages. New preset keys: min_candidates, plateau, plateau_eps.
changes.cost: Spends GPU time by design: 16-40 tries per sentence.
changes.risk: It is slow, which the teacher accepted. On CPU the cap is 12 and the ETA is shown (change 19).
changes.params: min 16; plateau 8 tries with eps 0.02; cap 40 / 20 low / 12 none

changes.stage: Cache: keep the best 6 candidates of every sentence
changes.change: Save the top K=6 candidates of each sentence as FLAC, plus their features and SV embeddings, next to the cached sentence. When the judge or the TwinProfile changes, re-rank the stored candidates without the GPU.
changes.why_more_alike: Today every losing candidate is deleted (engine.py L711) and only the best is stored (L813-818). The cross-sentence choice (change 11), her A/B swap (change 18) and later better measurements all need the alternatives.
changes.code_plan:
- synthesize_segment: write <key>.c<k>.flac, <key>.cand.npz (embeddings per member, prosody/LTAS vectors) and extend cand_info (L804-811) with file, ref id, aux, speed, refined.
- _rescore_cached (L628-666): re-rank when judge.signature() or the twin_profile signature changed.
- Remove .c* / .cand files when a sentence is regenerated (like the .dn* cleanup at L817-818).
- _tier_sig (L498-502): add every twin knob + TWIN_VERSION + profile signature + ref pool ids.
changes.cost: Disk estimate: about 1.2 MB of FLAC per sentence, about 120 MB per 100-sentence lecture. CPU negligible.
changes.risk: If the disk is full, persisting is skipped (non-fatal) and the cross-sentence choice treats that sentence as K=1. Old caches have K=1.
changes.test_without_gpu:
- Dummy run: at most 6 candidate files exist.
- Changing the profile signature re-ranks with backend.synthesize call count == 0.
- --redo removes old candidate files.
changes.params: K 6; FLAC; new CACHE_VERSION entry for twin

changes.stage: Whole lecture: choose candidates so neighbouring sentences sound continuous
changes.change:
Viterbi over the sentences of the lecture.
- States: each sentence's stored candidates in its best gate class, so a candidate that reads correctly and meets targets is never traded for one that does not.
- Node score: the twin total.
- Edge cost: 0.03 · Σ_f min(((Δ_f − μ_f,type) / σ_f,type)², 9), with f in {F0 median st, speech loudness before gain, log rate, timbre cosine distance (mean over SV members)}.
- type is phrase (chunks of one long sentence), sentence or paragraph, all measured from her consecutive units (change 1 f).
- For a redo, only the redone sentences are free and their neighbours stay fixed.
changes.why_more_alike: Each sentence is now chosen independently against one global centroid. In a lecture, listeners hear jumps in pitch level, loudness, tempo or timbre between neighbours as 'not the same person speaking continuously'. Long sentences cut into chunks (max_units_zh 50, script.py) also need phrase continuity. Penalising only deltas beyond HER own natural deltas avoids flattening her.
changes.code_plan: engine.py: new _twin_consistency(results), called in narrate after synthesize_all (L845-880) and before _layout (L1127). The SegmentResult wav/score is swapped to the chosen candidate. The report gets 'dp_changed' per sentence, plus a summary line with the count.
changes.cost: Measured 3 ms for 300 sentences x 6 candidates on the dev machine.
changes.risk: Over-smoothing is limited because the costs are relative to her measured deltas and capped. Weights are engineering values. Cached sentences without candidates count as K=1.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic results where the per-sentence best creates a 4-semitone jump → the DP chooses the consistent path. The redo test keeps neighbours fixed. The gate-class test never picks a candidate with a CER failure.
changes.params: w_transition 0.03 per feature; z clip 3; types phrase / sentence / paragraph

changes.stage: Assembly: her real pause lengths as exact digital silence (measure, then correct)
changes.change:
Twin _pause: target = inverse CDF of HER measured distribution for the class, at u drawn in [0.2, 0.8] from random.Random(base_seed + i).
- The class is comma (also used between chunks of one sentence), sentence, or paragraph. Paragraph = her p85-p97 of sentence gaps, because her paragraph boundaries are unknown.
- Explicit [停顿=x] values are kept.
- The pause is divided by the speed multiplier as today.
Then _fit_pauses: render, measure every gap in the output with the SAME detector that measured her (frame_rms_db 10/40 ms, auto threshold on the rendered file), shift the following sentence starts by (target − measured), and re-render. Two passes, shifts clamped to ±0.15 s.
The summary shows both measured numbers: 「停顿（实测）：你本人 逗号 x 秒 / 句号 y 秒；这次 x′ / y′」.
changes.why_more_alike:
Pauses are a strong 'that is her' cue in lectures.
- The profile side is biased: +32% in simulation, and 334 inner sentence ends are ignored.
- The output side was never re-measured. Simulation: the measured gap is the request + 0.03 s with synthetic speech; real GSV tails may differ.
- base ± 0.3·IQR (L1114-1125) does not reproduce her spread.
Using the same detector on both sides makes them comparable. The silence stays exact zeros because only start positions move.
changes.code_plan:
engine.py:
- _pause L1114-1125: twin branch reading twin_profile.
- New _fit_pauses called in narrate after _layout (L1127-1154), using _render (L1156-1166, untouched: placement into a zero buffer).
- Timed SRT mode (cue_start) is unchanged.
- LEAD_IN / LEAD_OUT (L110) are unchanged.
The detector is shared with change 1 (a new utils/audio.silent_gaps helper).
changes.cost: Two extra renders + detection: under 2 s CPU for a 10-minute file (estimate).
changes.risk: Very soft tails sit below the threshold on both sides, so they stay consistent. If correction fails, it keeps the uncorrected layout and logs it.
changes.params: u in [0.2, 0.8]; 2 passes; max shift ±0.15 s; detector hop 10 ms / win 40 ms

changes.stage: Assembly: loudness consistency between sentences, and no whole-file downscale for one peak
changes.why_more_alike: Sampling makes neighbouring sentences jump in level, which is never measured or penalised today. normalize_lufs + peak_limit (audio.py L244-258) scale the whole file down when there is one peak, ending below her level. Her within-lecture loudness spread is now measured.
changes.code_plan:
engine.py:
- New _twin_levels(results), applied to piece wavs before _render (L1156-1166).
- _write_audio (L1178-1195) skips the global peak_limit when per-sentence limiting was done.
- utils/audio.py gets a lookahead_limit helper.
Gain × 0 = 0, so the silence stays exact zeros.
changes.cost: Milliseconds.
changes.risk: Intentional emphasis is kept, because only deviations beyond her measured spread are shrunk. The limiter touches only samples above −1 dBFS.
changes.test_without_gpu: Synthetic sentences with ±6 dB jumps: the spread afterwards is at most her spread, the count of zero samples is unchanged, and in the peak case the global LUFS stays within 0.5 dB of the target.
changes.params: shrink factor min(1, σ_her/σ_gen); clamp her p05..p95; limiter ceiling −1 dBFS, lookahead 5 ms, release 50 ms

changes.stage: Sentence edges: keep her soft endings, score what she will hear
changes.why_more_alike: Soft endings (final lengthening, unvoiced finals, English final s/t, a trailing 了) are currently cut once they are 30 dB below the peak (engine.py L155-190), and listeners hear clipped word endings. Today the scored audio is the untrimmed one, with 0.3 s of zeros (L716-727), not what is delivered.
changes.code_plan: engine.py: trim_edges gets keyword params (drop_db, tail_pad_ms, keep_breath), called with twin values in attempt (L727). Scoring moves after trimming for twin; rate still uses speech_activity, which works on trimmed audio with zero pads.
changes.cost: Microseconds to milliseconds.
changes.risk: A lower threshold could keep vocoder hiss at the tail; the floor-relative threshold, LTAS and CER checks guard this. Silence between sentences is guaranteed by _render.
changes.test_without_gpu: A synthetic burst with an 80 ms exponential tail: twin trim keeps at least 70 ms of tail, while the current trim keeps less. First and last samples are 0. A hiss-only file still trims to empty (extends test_trim_edges_removes_hiss_and_starts_at_zero, tests/test_pipeline.py L220).
changes.params: tail drop 45 dB; floor +12 dB; pad 30-120 ms from her data; breath threshold 30% of clips

changes.stage: Post-processing: long-term spectrum match to her voice (capped, accepted only if the judge agrees)
changes.change:
Whole-lecture match EQ.
- Compare the mean LTAS of the chosen sentences (at least 60 s of speech) with hers.
- Correction = clip(Δ_b, ±3 dB), only where |Δ_b| > 1 dB in 3 or more adjacent bands, smoothed per one-third octave.
- Linear-phase FIR (scipy.signal.firwin2, 1025 taps at 32 kHz) applied to each trimmed sentence with mode 'same', then the 4/8 ms edge fades are re-applied before placement.
- Accept only if the mean judge pct drops by 0.5 points or less AND the LTAS distance decreases; otherwise skip and log.
- Applied identically in both variants.
changes.why_more_alike: The vocoder/32 kHz path, or denoising, can leave the voice duller or brighter than hers. SV cannot see above 8 kHz. A long-term spectral match (standard 'match EQ' in audio post-production) moves brightness toward her measured voice without adding any sound.
changes.code_plan: engine.py: new _match_eq(results), called in narrate before _render (L1156-1166) and before _make_variants (L1047-1089). It uses twin_judge.ltas_bands. The report records the measured per-band correction.
changes.cost: FIR on a 10-minute lecture is under 1 s (estimate). Re-judging every sentence for acceptance: 0.74 s each on the dev machine, about 1-2 min per 100 sentences.
changes.risk: Over-correction from content differences is limited by the lecture-wide average, the ±3 dB cap and the acceptance test. Filtering happens on segments before placement into the zero buffer, so the silence between sentences stays exact zeros.
changes.test_without_gpu: Dummy narration low-passed at 7 kHz, with the profile built from unfiltered material: the EQ boosts the high bands and lowers the LTAS distance, and every between-sentence sample is still 0. A fake judge that drops 2 points makes the EQ reject itself.
changes.params: cap ±3 dB; min |Δ| 1 dB over 3 or more adjacent bands; 1025 taps; acceptance: pct drop <= 0.5

changes.stage: Two variants (未去杂音 / 去杂音) judged on spectrum, not only timbre
changes.change:
Version B denoises a sentence only when the floor inside its speech is measurable: the 10th percentile of frame dB in the voiced region is above −60 dBFS. Otherwise that sentence is identical to A.
The recommendation uses the mean twin total (timbre + prosody + rhythm + LTAS, no ASR) instead of _version_score.
The variant note shows the measured high-band difference.
changes.why_more_alike: Denoising can dull timbre, and the difference between A and B is mostly spectral. The current recommendation (engine.py L1025-1045) is dominated by speaker similarity and cannot see it.
changes.code_plan: engine.py: _make_variants (L1047-1089) and _denoised (L1091-1111) get a twin branch; _version_score is replaced for twin. task_stages uses the twin stage list (change 19).
changes.cost: About the same as today.
changes.risk: If noisereduce is missing, only A is produced, with the existing Chinese note.
changes.test_without_gpu: A monkeypatched denoise_light that low-passes → A is recommended. A noisy candidate (floor −45 dBFS) → B is recommended. Clean sentences are identical in A and B.
changes.params: denoise only if the in-speech floor is above −60 dBFS; strength 0.5 (as today)

changes.stage: Checkpoint selection after training, judged like generation and against her same-sentence recordings
changes.why_more_alike: Today selection uses fixed pick_reference, no aux, one seed (select.py L196-200), cos/p50 ranking with pct only logged (L241), and skips failures (L202-207). The checkpoint best under those conditions may not be best for 一模一样 generation. Ground-truth prosody (her recording of the same sentence) exists for every validation item but is used only as a duration ratio.
changes.code_plan: select.py: select_and_calibrate (L123-271) gets a twin mode, plus helper functions in eval/twin_judge.py (dtw_f0_corr, pause_agreement). Called from workflows run_train auto-select (L775-809) and run_select (L875-894) when quality resolves to twin. models.json gets the per-item measured table.
changes.cost: Syntheses = checkpoints x 30 x 3. For today's 12-checkpoint grid that is 1080, against 240 now (4.5x). Estimate 1-2 h on her PC (not measured; today's selection time exists only in her logs). DTW plus features is about 50 ms per pair (estimate).
changes.risk: Longer. If the twin profile is missing, it falls back to today's scoring. Seeds are deterministic.
changes.params: 3 seeds; 30 items; bootstrap 1000; score = mean of best-of-3

changes.stage: Her own ears as the final judge (optional, learns from her picks)
changes.change:
In the per-sentence result table: when a row is selected, show 「备选版本」 (the runner-up from the stored candidates) and a button 「换成这个版本」.
- Swapping re-renders the lecture with no GPU (pauses, levels and EQ re-applied).
- Every pick is logged with both feature vectors.
- After 30 or more picks, fit a ridge-regularised Bradley-Terry / logistic model on the feature differences (T, P, R, S, accuracy), with the default weights as the prior and λ = 10.
- The learned weights are used only if leave-one-out accuracy is at least 60%. That accuracy is shown as measured: 「按你选过的 N 次调整了挑选方式，能猜中你的选择 xx%（实测）」.
changes.why_more_alike: No machine judge truly knows what makes listeners say 'that is exactly her'; her ears are the ground truth. This turns her quick listening into better automatic choices for every later lecture.
changes.code_plan:
- webui/app.py: next to gen_table (L4290) / seg_audio (L4294), add an audio component, a button and their handlers.
- workflows.py: swap_candidate(cfg, voice, report_path, index, cand_id) re-runs changes 12, 13 and 15 on the stored candidates (change 10) and rewrites the outputs atomically.
- eval/twin_judge.py: learn_weights(prefs) writes workspace/<voice>/twin_prefs.jsonl and twin_weights.json.

designs.honest_message:
老师您好，「一模一样」是新的最高档，以后每次都默认用它（除非您自己改选别的档）。它会做这些事：

1. 先从您自己的录音里实测您的说话习惯：逗号、句号处一般停多久，音调的高低和起伏，句尾怎么收，长句短句各说多快，前后句子的音量差多少，声音的明亮程度，句子开头结尾是什么样子。
2. 生成时，每句话试很多次，还会换几条和这句话最搭的您的录音当参考（疑问句用您的疑问语气，英文例句用您讲英文的那几句）。然后用几个声纹模型加上上面实测的习惯一起打分，挑最像您的。
3. 整篇再挑一遍，让前后句子的音调、音量、语速衔接得像您连着讲课。
4. 句子之间的停顿按您实测的长短放，停顿里是绝对的数字静音（全是 0），没有任何底噪。最后再量一遍，确认停顿的长短和您的一致。
5. 音量按您原来的录音调，句子之间的音量差也不会比您平时大。
6. 结果页上显示的数字，比如「停顿：您本人 0.3 秒，这次 0.3 秒」，全是程序实际量出来的。量不出来的项目会直接写「没测出来」。
7. 您觉得哪一句不太像，可以点一下听备选版本，换成您觉得更像的那一个。您选得多了，程序会慢慢学会按您的耳朵挑。

它做不到的：

1. 不可能百分之百和您一模一样。「一模一样」是目标，不是保证。机器打分会有误差，最后请以您的耳朵为准。
2. 英文例句的口音，主要取决于训练时模型有没有学到您的英文。打分只能在已经学到的范围里挑最好的。英文句子的「像不像」分数也没有中文准。
3. 您的录音句子之间是完全静音，所以生成的音频也不留呼吸声，不加任何背景声。

需要的时间（很慢，因为要用满显卡、每句试很多次）：

1. 一篇 10 分钟的讲稿，估计要 1～4 个小时。没有 N 卡的电脑会慢很多。生成时程序会实测每试一次要多久，并显示「预计还要多久」。建议晚上开始，让它慢慢做完。
2. 第一次用「一模一样」训练时，模型要重新训练，时间比上次的 30.6 分钟（实测）长。训练页会按实际进度显示。

scores.comments: I checked this against the code and it holds up. (1) The N-copies batch trick is sound. In abe9843 TTS.py, cut0 returns the text unchanged and pre_seg_text splits on '\n'; merge_short_text_in_array(…,5) is real, and the replica correctly sends short texts to single requests. infer_panel_batch_infer samples each row independently with multinomial, and identical copies need no padding, so each row is a fair independent draw. speed!=1.0 takes the serial per-fragment decode path (TTS.py ~1262); at exactly 1.0 all fragments are concatenated into ONE vits decode (~1236), which would mix the copies. In models.py, speed!=1 interpolates to int(L/speed)+1, which equals L for 1.0001 and L<10000; the prototype confirms 0 changes. audio_postprocess normalises each fragment and appends int(sr*fragment_interval) exact zeros, so splitting the answer on zero runs works. batch_size, parallel_infer, fragment_interval, seed, top_k/top_p/temperature, repetition_penalty and aux_ref_audio_paths all exist in both api_v2 versions. The top_k defaults it cites are correct: 15 in abe9843, 5 in 20250606v2pro. The OOM path is also correct: TTS.run catches the error, returns 200 + 1 s of 16 kHz zeros and reloads the weights, and errors.FATAL_KEYS contains gpu_oom. (2) The text_lang bug is real. gptsovits.py sends 'en' whenever seg.lang=='en'; detect_lang returns 'en' when cjk < 0.2*words; 'en' mode passes the whole line to english g2p and replace_phs drops the CJK. (3) The legacy config claim is correct: default_config had 'quality: balanced' from 27a539a/5b46851 until 4ea4ca9, and the installer keeps config.yaml. The line references (engine _ref_for 485-496, _tier_sig 498-502, deleted cands ~711, app.py 4255 value='balanced', 3645 fallback, TIER_QUALITY) are accurate. Weaknesses: (a) it does not fix the biggest verified data gap, English stripped at training, and only asks another team for it; (b) the bit-exact self-check can fail by chance because set_seed leaves cudnn.deterministic off, which silently drops the speed-1.0 batching (safe, but the throughput gain is lost); (c) a v4 checkpoint with parallel_infer uses using_vocoder_synthesis_batched_infer (not the per-fragment VITS path), and v4 ignores aux refs, so batching and aux arms for v4 are not covered; (d) the second resident api_v2 on an 8 GB laptop is very unlikely to pass its gate and adds complexity; (e) checkpoint re-ranking covers only the top-3 of the old 4x3 grid. On hardware use: it squeezes the most out of the GPU at inference time (batching, OOM halving, pipelining, cascade, optional judge on the GPU), but there is no probe for the training batch size.

It finds and fixes the largest measured fidelity gap. I re-ran the scratchpad measurement on the repo's 母本: 1004 kept lines, all tagged zh, 559 with English, 2080 English words (6.1% of syllables), 112 lines ending mid-sentence. Official 1-get-text runs clean_text(text,'zh'); chinese2.replace_punctuation then deletes every Latin character with re.sub('[^一-龥'+punct+']+'). Inference does it differently (TextPreprocessor else-branch: LangSegmenter, en→ARPAbet with zero BERT). So training and inference disagree on 56% of lines. The mixed 1A plan copies the inference merge rule exactly and respects the s1 dataset assert (bert.shape[-1]==len(phones); a missing bert file means None). It has a pure-zh self-check and falls back to official 1A, so it fails safe. Other points I verified: s1longer-v2.yaml epochs 20 / save 1; the data_module cap len//4; GPT steps every 4 batches; a stamp that hashes only the list text (so re-rendered audio would reuse stale features); selection that today uses 1 seed, no aux, pick_reference and skips failures (select.py 195-209); and V4 support in the bundle (s2_train_v3_lora, the v3v4set batch rule minmem//8, 3-get-semantic choosing by size; the pretrained files must be downloaded, per research/gsv_v4_v5). The training batch probe (it detects the Windows sysmem spill from peak memory and throughput, not just OOM), the step-down OOM ladder, measured nvidia-smi utilisation, the two parallel feature parts and the num_workers change answer the teacher's 'squeeze the GPU' demand for training better than either other design. Selection is deep: every checkpoint, 44 items, 2-3 seeds, failures counted as the worst score, a bootstrap tie that keeps 2 models, and the old 30.6-minute model kept as a competitor. Problems: (a) the optional screening batch mode for selection relies on split_bucket at speed 1.0, which is the concatenated single VITS decode, so items contaminate each other through enc_p. The agreement gate limits the damage, but it should use the per-fragment path (speed 1.0001) or be dropped. (b) 'A bigger batch only fills the GPU, it does not change how much is learned' is wrong. Matching update counts with ceil(E·b/4) epochs (up to 48 SoVITS epochs) means more passes over the data and a higher overfitting risk; only selection protects against that. (c) It changes a lot: training data (final 「，」, front end, possibly re-rendered clip audio), forced fresh training, a new training-mode default and an optional 1.5-4.5 h V4. Fallbacks exist, but the risk to existing features is higher. (d) Generation-side search is left to the other designs.

There are good perceptual levers here, and I verified the claims about the current code. profile.py takes pauses only from gap_after and inner pauses, skips clips with inner sentence marks, and builds pitch from one median and one std. metrics clips pct_raw to [-50,150]. speaker.judge_embeddings computes the spread but nothing uses it. trim_edges uses a fixed threshold, and scoring happens on untrimmed audio. Every chunk of a long question gets sentence_kind(sent) (script.py ~321). raw/<sid>.wav exists (prepare.py ~516). In api_v2, set_seed runs before GPT sampling and speed only enters the enc_p interpolation, so the same-seed tempo refinement is a valid idea, but it depends on cuDNN determinism, which is off, so its duration check is needed. Pauses that are measured and corrected with the same detector, per-sentence constant gains and Viterbi continuity all keep exact zeros between sentences (they only move starts and apply gain), so the silence rule holds. Weaknesses: (a) no GPU batching, no training batch probe and sequential tries, all deferred to 'the GPU/search design', so it does poorly on the teacher's repeated 'use the full GPU' demand; (b) it does not fix the verified training-side English gap; (c) the tone-aware check is technically invalid: pypinyin tones of the ASR text reflect which characters the recogniser chose, not how she pronounced the tones; (d) it says 'every installer wrote synth.quality: auto', which is FALSE: default_config had 'quality: balanced' from 5b46851 until 4ea4ca9 and the installer keeps config.yaml, so honouring 'any other value' silently keeps the old balanced default in the CLI, against the teacher's always-default requirement; (e) the match EQ is accepted on the same LTAS distance it optimises, by a judge that cannot hear above 8 kHz (circular); (f) moving 10 extra clips into val takes 2 of her only 20 questions out of training. The many hand-set weights (0.06, 0.04, 0.03) should be calibrated on val the way the search design proposes.

judges.best_ideas:
Below are the best individual changes I would keep from the three designs (I checked each against the code and the official api_v2/TTS.py):

1. **Mixed-text routing for synthesis (search, perception 6c).** Send text_lang/prompt_lang 'zh' whenever the text has any CJK character. Put the routed language in the cache key. This is a verified bug fix for every tier.

2. **Mixed zh/en training front end (model).** A VoiceTwin 1A that uses the official clean_text, LangSegmenter and roberta functions and copies the inference merge rule. English segments get zero BERT; s1 asserts bert.shape[-1]==len(phones). It has a pure-zh self-check and falls back to the official 1A. Report how many English phones were actually trained, as a measured number. Of all the proposals, this is the largest gap verified in the code (559/1004 lines; 2080 English words never trained).

3. **Training clips that end mid-sentence (model).** These are 112 measured clips: export 「，」 instead of 「。」. The feature stamp should also cover a signature of the audio files and the front-end version.

4. **Training hardware use (model).**
   - Probe the batch size with the official scripts on the longest clips, detecting Windows sysmem spill from peak memory and throughput.
   - On OOM, step down one size at a time.
   - Record measured nvidia-smi utilisation and peak memory.
   - Run feature extraction as 2 parallel parts.
   - Set GPT num_workers.
   - Audit how many clips were actually trained (from the s1/s2 logs).
   - Use the template's dense saving (GPT every epoch) plus a disk guard.

5. **Deep checkpoint selection (model + search + perception).**
   - Every saved checkpoint, screened in stages, under the same conditions as 一模一样 generation (matched references, aux 3, 2-3 seeds).
   - Score against her same-sentence real recordings: to_real, duration and F0 contour after DTW.
   - A failed synthesis counts as the worst score instead of being skipped.
   - Paired bootstrap: on a tie, keep 2 models as generation arms.
   - The previous 30.6-minute model competes and stays if the new one is not better.
   - Speed is recalibrated under generation conditions.
   - Calibrate the ranking weights on val with leave-one-item-out and adopt them only past a margin (search).

6. **Batched candidates in one request (search).** N '\n'-separated copies, cut0, batch_size=N, parallel_infer, speed 1.0001 to force the per-fragment VITS path. Split strictly on the exact-zero fragment_interval runs; the replica decides when to fall back to single requests.
   - On OOM, halve B down to 1, then use the existing fatal path.
   - Auto-tune B by measured candidates per second.
   - The self-check should compare within a tolerance, not bit-exact.

7. **Producer thread and cascade scoring (search).** A producer thread keeps api_v2 busy while candidates are scored: a cheap first stage on every candidate, then the full ensemble + ASR on the top 12, keeping at least one per arm.

8. **Reference bank and matching (search + perception).**
   - A bank of her confirmed clips, trimmed to 3.2-9.8 s (the api's 3-10 s limit).
   - Per-sentence shortlist by kind (only the final chunk of a question counts as a question), length, English share and paragraph position (perception).
   - A measured prior from a reference audition on val against her real recordings.
   - Arms: reference x aux {0,3} x the two official top_k defaults (15 / 5), plus a CER-rescue preset.
   - Group requests by ref/aux to reuse the prompt cache.

9. **Timbre term (search; perception has the same idea).** Consensus lower bound (mean − 0.5·spread), saturating at her natural range, so that being 'more central than her' is not rewarded.

10. **Mixed CER check (search, perception).** Paraformer for the CJK part, Whisper for the Latin words. Count deletions and substitutions only.

11. **Stopping rule and top-K store (search, perception).** A minimum budget, then targets + plateau, up to a cap. Store the top-K candidates so a redo continues the search, and re-rank without the GPU when the judge changes.

12. **Perception assembly levers (they keep exact zeros).**
    - A TwinProfile measured on the full sources (unbiased pause statistics; clause pauses aligned to punctuation).
    - Pauses measured and corrected with the same detector.
    - Sentence loudness spread capped at hers.
    - Same-seed speed refinement, guarded by a duration check.
    - Viterbi continuity over the stored candidates, constrained to the gate class.
    - A floor-relative tail trim, with scoring on the delivered audio.
    - Optional learning from her A/B picks (n ≥ 30, leave-one-out ≥ 60%).

13. **Defaults (search + model).**
    - 'identical' for auto, empty and unknown values on every VRAM tier.
    - The radio resets on every page load, and do_generate falls back to identical.
    - The CLI default is identical.
    - Old 'quality: balanced' files (exact legacy comment, model's regex) are treated as auto, or a synth.quality_locked flag is used (search).
    - The training page gets a 训练方式 radio defaulting to 一模一样.
    - Weak or CPU machines keep the default with smaller caps, a measured ETA and the option to switch.

14. **Optional V4 LoRA (model).** Only when the files, peft and VRAM are all present, and only measured against v2ProPlus on her val. Note that v4 ignores aux refs and sv_emb.
judges.reject:
These changes should be dropped or reworked:

1. **Tone-aware pypinyin check (perception 6b).** It reads tones off the characters the ASR chose, so it cannot detect tones she actually mispronounced. It would mostly measure homophone choices by the recogniser.

2. **'Every installer wrote synth.quality: auto' (perception).** This is factually wrong. 5b46851 to 4ea4ca9 shipped 'quality: balanced', and the installer keeps config.yaml. Honouring it would silently override the 一模一样 default in the CLI. Treat the legacy value as auto (model's regex) or require synth.quality_locked (search).

3. **Selection 'screening batch mode' with split_bucket at speed 1.0 (model).** At speed==1.0 TTS.py concatenates all fragments into a single vits decode, so the items influence each other through enc_p. Either use the per-fragment path (speed 1.0001 or another speed !=1) or drop it.

4. **Bit-exact int16 self-check for the 1.0001 trick (search).** set_seed leaves cudnn.deterministic off, so the check can fail by chance and silently disable batching. Use a tolerance, or compare duration and correlation.

5. **Second resident api_v2 server (search).** It is unrealistic on the teacher's 8 GB laptop alongside ASR and the judge, the GPU is already saturated by batching, and it adds failure modes. Keep it off.

6. **Lecture-wide match EQ (perception).** Its acceptance test uses the same LTAS distance it optimises, and the judge cannot hear above 8 kHz, so it is circular and may colour the voice. At most, report the LTAS difference.

7. **Enlarging val by moving clips out of train (perception).** It removes 2 of her only 20 questions from training and breaks the fair comparison with the old model. Use built-in test texts for coverage instead (model).

8. **The model's rationale that a bigger batch 'does not change how much is learned'.** Scaling to ceil(E·b/4) epochs (up to 48 SoVITS) is more passes over the data and a higher overfit risk. Keep the probe, but state this honestly and rely on selection.

9. **super_sampling, and sample_steps for v2ProPlus.** super_sampling only applies to v3 and sample_steps only to v3/v4, so they must not be presented as v2ProPlus levers (none of the designs relies on them; the model sends sample_steps only for v4). aux_ref_audio_paths and sv_emb are ignored by v4 (refer_spec[0] only), so aux arms collapse for v4 checkpoints. v4 with parallel_infer goes through the batched vocoder path, so the copy-batching proof (VITS per-fragment) does not cover v4. Either use parallel_infer=False with per-fragment synthesis for v4, or skip batching for v4.

10. **Unmeasured time and VRAM numbers in the teacher-facing messages.** For example, the search design's '20-50 分钟' and the model design's '3-5 小时'. They must stay labelled 估计 until measured on her PC; all three designs mostly do this already.

I checked the core mechanism against the real code and it holds. In both abe9843 TTS.py (L1236-1271) and tag 20250606v2pro (L1238-1262), speed_factor==1.0 decodes all fragments together as one sequence (enc_p attention can mix the copies). Any other speed decodes each fragment separately. models.py enc_p uses F.interpolate(size=int(L/speed)+1). I re-ran the prototype: no L in 1..9999 changes length at 1.0001. I also re-ran the replica: 1004/1004 of her lines give exactly 4 identical fragments; '好的。' and '对。' merge (batched_n=2), so the fallback is needed. GPT rows are sampled independently: multinomial_sample_one_no_sync draws its own random number for each element. Every field used (batch_size, parallel_infer, speed_factor, fragment_interval, seed, top_k/top_p/temperature, aux_ref_audio_paths, text_split_method cut0) exists in both real TTS_Request classes. sample_steps and super_sampling are not used for v2ProPlus, which is correct. Further facts confirmed: P1 top_k 5 is the 20250606v2pro default and P0 top_k 15 is the abe9843 default. A reference outside 3-10 s raises an error (TTS.py L816-817). After an OOM the real api answers 200 with 1 s of 16 kHz silence. The models are not reloaded, because the reload code comes after a yield that is never resumed, so halving B and retrying is sound. The cancel flag is a global Event, so the producer thread sees Stop. The legacy-config claim is true: default_config had 'quality: balanced' up to 4ea4ca9, and init-config keeps an existing config.yaml.
Risks:
- The self-check that expects bit-identical int16 between the 1.0 and 1.0001 paths can fail because of GPU nondeterminism. That fails safe (batching is just turned off), but it needs a tolerance.
- The split does not return 'the same bytes': the fragment's own trailing exact zeros merge into the gap. This is harmless.
- The second resident api_v2 on her RTX 5070 Laptop (about 6.8 GB free, plus Whisper large-v3-turbo in the VoiceTwin process) is too tight. Windows sysmem fallback turns overflow into a slowdown rather than an OOM. The design gates it, but it is not worth the complexity.
- The GPU ONNX judge probably has no CUDA provider in the bundle; it is optional.
- Re-ranking, audition and weight calibration all reuse the same 20 val clips that anchor the 100% calibration. That gives an optimistic bias; the bootstrap and shrinkage help only partly.
- No training-side resource squeeze at all: training stays the 30.6-minute config.
- The honest message says 「显卡一直满负荷工作」, but GPU use is never measured. Show nvidia-smi utilization instead.
The CPU-only default is very slow, but the design says so honestly.

The biggest finding is verified. Official 1-get-text.py runs clean_text(text, lan). chinese2.text_normalize calls replace_punctuation, whose regex [^一-龥 + punct] deletes every Latin letter.
